jobs.title: Digital Literacy Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**POSITION:** Digital Literacy Program Coordinator

**REPORTS TO:** Volunteer Program Manager

**THE ORGANIZATION:** Conard House, Inc. is a non-profit organization that focuses on empowering people and restoring hope for our community members and workforce. We work with a diverse adult population and strive for cultural competency by respecting experience, promoting inclusion and building community. The position is with the SF Connected program, which provides various services including: computer training, resume building, tablet training, social media training, and other services that improve the quality of life/independence of older adults and adults with disabilities in San Francisco. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Conard House is a committed equal opportunity employer.

**QUALIFICATIONS:** High School Diploma required; Bachelor's degree preferred. Must have at least two years of experience in a technology-focused, educational, or human services role working with diverse populations. Demonstrate the ability to clearly communicate ideas, information, and technical concepts to individuals and groups with varying levels of knowledge, education, and digital literacy, while providing troubleshooting, training, and technology guidance in a supportive and accessible manner. Demonstrate positive customer service and client-centered approaches when interacting with participants, staff, volunteers, and community members. Must be comfortable with public speaking, group facilitation, and delivering presentations, classes, or workshops. Demonstrate experience developing, implementing, and evaluating curriculum, educational materials, or training programs, as well as coordinating projects and collaborating effectively across diverse teams, departments, and community partners. Experience working with and supervising volunteers is highly desirable. Must complete a background check after conditional job offer.

**DUTIES:**

* Develop curriculum for classes that is suitable for Conard House consumers that will include usage of computers and commonly used software and apps.
* Train and assist consumers on assistive technologies and accessibility features to promote independence and enhance consumers’ daily living.
* Design and implement training programs that will help improve and enhance daily living for consumers.
* Assist consumers with job search process, including resume revision, cover letter composition, and online applications.
* Assist consumers with troubleshooting on personal tech devices, platforms, and processes. Maintain the ability to adjust approach(es) as needed to best suit consumer needs.
* Host/train consumers and volunteers on video conferencing platforms/software to allow clients to learn, participate/engage in virtual activities and virtual learning opportunities.
* Coordinate workshops, guest speakers, and special events that promote digital inclusion and community engagement.
* Deliver personalized strength-based training; encourage and support participant interaction.
* Coordinate, train, support, and oversee volunteers and interns assisting with Digital Literacy programming.
* Develop and disseminate program materials to all Conard sites.
* Conduct program outreach, both internally at associated Conard sites as well as with potential and established external partners.
* Coordinate class scheduling with site supervisors in the community.
* Design group activities that promote social connection opportunities for consumers.
* Track program objectives and class attendance, including individual usage and student progress.
* Collect & compile data for distribution of monthly reports and input data into the appropriate database.
* Coordinate Digital Literacy program inventory, including ordering and tracking incoming and outgoing devices.
* Maintain accurate program records and ensure compliance with agency, contract, and confidentiality requirements.
* Manage technology equipment, coordinate security of equipment at sites, report issues with equipment or lab operations.
* Coordinate and network with other agencies that are participating in SF Connected. Attend meetings as required.
* Maintain a classroom environment suitable for collaborative learning.
* Be available to assist consumers virtually and remotely.
* Others duties as assigned.

Pay: $30.94 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 403(b)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Application Question(s):

* Are you available to work Monday to Friday 9 am to 5 pm?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* curriculum development: 1 year (Preferred)
* social services: 1 year (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* San Francisco, CA 94103 (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Learning and Development Program Specialist supporting Nvidia
jobs.description:
**Sustainable Talent** is partnering with **NVIDIA**, a global leader that has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 25 years. We are now looking for a **Learning and Development Program Specialist** to support Nvidia's growing team.

  

This is a full-time (W-2) **contract** role based in **Santa Clara, CA.** We offer competitive pay **$40/hr - $50/hr** based on factors like experience, education, location, etc. and provide full benefits, PTO, and amazing company culture!

  

Learning & Development Coordinators work closely with Learning Program Managers to support and deliver our learning programs. We are looking for someone who works independently and collaboratively, enjoys cross-functional partnerships, and brings solid experience in learning program management.

  

**What you will be doing:**

* Planning the learning calendar based on organizational needs.
* Coordinating 1:1 coaching programs end to end.
* Producing and managing online, live, and hybrid learning events.
* Handling program communications and LMS administration.
* Developing and curating learning resources and marketing materials.
* Preparing speakers and instructors for successful delivery.
* Tracking learning data and managing learner communities on Slack and Teams.
* Gathering feedback, managing deliverables, and mitigating risks to drive program adoption.

  

**What we need to see:**

* Someone who enjoys creative problem-solving and can take our client's learning roadmap from concept to execution, managing rollout, adoption, and ongoing maintenance along the way.
* **Background in adult learning:** degrees in Education, Psychology, or Communications, or equivalent experience in learning roles.
* Hands-on experience coordinating **global learning programs at scale** with an aptitude for experimentation and iteration.
* Proficiency with business and AI tools including Claude, ChatGPT, MS Office, Smartsheet, Lovable, and Canva.

  

**About Sustainable Talent**

Sustainable Talent is a certified woman-owned company specializing in recruitment, consulting, and workforce solutions. We partner with innovative organizations to connect exceptional talent with meaningful opportunities across technology, engineering, operations, and professional services.

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sustainable Talent is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

jobs.title: Bilingual Program Coordinator Direct Service
jobs.description:
**Are you a skilled professional who believes in lending your skills to end hunger during these unprecedented times? If so, consider being the** **Bilingual Program Coordinator, Direct Service** **for the San Francisco-Marin Food Bank.** Join our friendly, collaborative, and hardworking programs team, reporting to the Program Supervisor.

The Bilingual Program Coordinator, Direct Service is responsible for providing onsite support at our staff-led Community Markets. This is a fixed term position anticipated to end June 30, 2028.

Who We Are:

**Our mission** is to end hunger in San Francisco and Marin.

**We envision** a just and equitable society that nurtures a resilient community. We envision a community where everyone will have access to nutritious food of their choosing and will be uplifted by a network of support. We work with our community to create lasting solutions to address both the hunger we see today and the root causes that perpetuate food insecurity in our society. Every week, over 50,000 households count on us for food assistance. 60% of what we distribute is fresh fruits and vegetables.

Who You Are:

To excel in this position, you will need to approach the work with the following habits and values:

* **Collaboration and Teamwork:** Partners with others to get work done. Gains trust and support of others. Does own fair share of the work. Seeks assistance from other team members, as needed. Volunteers assistance and undertakes additional tasks to support others. Acknowledges colleagues accomplishments and shares credit on collaborative work.
* **Values Differences/Embraces Inclusion and Diversity:** Seeks to understand different perspectives and cultures. Contributes to a work climate where differences are valued and supported and want to do their best. Self-aware and considerate of how bias, poor treatment and conflict is handled and demonstrates valuing others. Is sensitive to cultural norms, expectations and ways of communicating.
* **Customer Focus/Service Orientation:** Collaborates with colleagues to deliver high-quality service. Actively listens and asks questions to determine participant/volunteer needs. Suggests ways to improve the participant experience. Demonstrates values of caring, respect, honesty, and responsibility in all interacting with staff, volunteers, and participants. Establishes and maintains effective participant/volunteer relationships.
* **Judgement:** Considers the long-term as well as immediate short-term outcomes and actions. Recognizes when to escalate appropriate of specific situations to the next higher level of expertise. Considers alternative available actions, resources, and constraints before selecting a method for accomplishing a task or project. Confirms details before deciding how to act. Seeks out others to check or review their own work for accuracy and completeness. Reviews all relevant information or aspects of a situation before acting or deciding.
* **Self-Awareness and Professionalism:** Reflects on activities and impact on others. Proactively seeks feedback without being defensive. Is open to criticism and talking about shortcomings. Admits mistakes and gains insight from experiences. Is conscious of an manages how ones actions and reactions impact others. Knows strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and limits. Knows how to conduct self in the workplace: communicates effectively, resolves conflict, does not gossip, acts with integrity, and holds professional boundaries.
* **Delivers Commitments:** Follows through on commitments. Acts with a clear sense of ownership. Takes personal responsibility for decisions, actions and failures. Are seen as direct and truthful. Solves issues, rather than focusing on blame. Identifies and communicates what they need of others, and shares that with them directly and professionally.

What You Would Be Accountable for:

The Bilingual Program Coordinator, Direct Services will be responsible for the following key pieces of work:

* Program implementation: site set up, product receipt, operation, safety and clean-up.
* Volunteer management: train, assign roles and ensure best practices are being followed.
* Site environment: distributions are welcoming and provide a positive experience for everyone.
* Participant support: effectively communicate information and use technology to streamline and track program implementation.

What You Would Be Doing Right Now:

* Provide onsite support at our staff-led Community Markets: volunteer management, grocery distribution, choice management, participant support, and support the co-location with support services.
* Ensure food availability at community markets through food 'ordering', inventory management, and assessment of product movement
* Complete administrative responsibilities, including communicating pertinent information to team members, creating market signage, developing participant written communications, reporting attendance and food inventory, and communicating with participants via ZenDesk.
* Maintain required job knowledge, skills and core competencies. Attend and engage in required trainings and team meetings.
* Represent the Food Bank in the community by engaging with participants, volunteers, partners, and community members.
* Assist in resolving complex and sensitive customer service issues, either in person, by phone, or in writing; maintain records/documentation of customer service issues and/or involve leadership to ensure appropriate resolution
* Support other programs with direct service and/or administrative responsibilities, as needed.
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends
* Perform other duties, as assigned.

What Else You Should Know:

**All internal candidates must apply using their Food Bank work email within 10 business days of posting to be considered. Applications submitted after 10 days are still welcome but may not be reviewed or afforded an interview, depending on the status of the selection process.**

**PREFERRED

jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**

Established in Taiwan in 1974, Hon Hai Technology Group, commonly known as Foxconn, is the world’s largest electronics manufacturer and leading provider of technological solutions with a network of over 233 campuses across 24 countries. In the US, Foxconn employs 8,000 across 56 different sites with manufacturing operations in Virginia, Wisconsin, Ohio, Indiana, Texas, and California. As of 2025, Foxconn ranks 28th among the Fortune Global 500 and reported revenue of approximately USD $259 billion.

The company’s diverse product offerings span four major segments: smart consumer electronics, cloud, and networking solutions, computing, and various other components. Foxconn makes 40% of the consumer electronics that we find in our everyday lives. In recent years, Hon Hai has adopted the 3+3 strategy, focusing on three emerging industries - electric vehicles, digital health solutions, and robotics - while leveraging three key technologies: next-generation communications, artificial intelligence (AI), and semiconductors. Together, these initiatives position the company as a leader in innovation for the 21st century.

Hon Hai Technology Group is deeply committed to championing environmental sustainability within its manufacturing processes. By integrating sustainability into its operations framework, the company strives to serve as a best-practice model for global enterprises, enhancing corporate responsibility while meeting the growing demand for environmentally conscious production methods.

**Job Summary:**

The HR Generalist leads HR work for the start-up of the Santa Clara NPI site. The role builds the HR foundation for commissioning, ramp-up, and ongoing operations. The role shifts from start-up work to normal operations and adjusts HR support as the site moves through each phase. The role sets local HR strategy and works with plant leadership to establish the local business culture while partnering with regional HR.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

* Works with regional HR, shared services, and TA to staff and onboard the site.
* Partners with plant leadership on workforce planning and hiring decisions.
* Manages agency relationships and screens agency candidates for technician-level capability.

Employee Relations & Performance Management

* Works with staffing partners on performance or conduct issues while ensuring agency workers are managed consistently with plant practices.
* Leads ER for plant employees and builds an issue‑resolution culture that resolves concerns early and supports engagement.
* Reinforces the local business culture through leader coaching and consistent application of plant practices.

Compliance & Risk Management

* Ensures compliance with federal, state, and local laws and maintains clean HR practices.
* Works with local leaders to identify risks and develop solutions that support operations.
* Engages regional HR on significant issues and partners with the region when broader support is needed.

Compensation, Benefits & HR Operations

* Coordinates with regional HR and shared services on compensation, benefits, and HR operations and provides insight into local market practices.
* Supports linkages between local HR activities and HR shared services to ensure correct execution.
* Ensures all HR documents and entries are complete and accurate for payroll and HR systems and reporting.

Workforce Analytics & Reporting

* Monitors workforce trends and uses local data to identify issues and develop solutions.
* Leads local reporting and analysis that support start-up and ongoing operations.
* Maintains HR records that support regional reporting.

Safety, Customer & Cross-Functional Support

* Supports site start-up activities with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and EHS.
* Coordinates onboarding, orientation, and job-related training with regional L&D to support workforce readiness.
* Supports the establishment of the safety culture and reinforces practices that support engagement and retention.

Leadership Responsibilities

* Coaches plant leaders on performance and communication and champions company values.
* Builds leader capability for a high-automation environment.
* Supports BU employees on-site with routine ER needs and aligns escalations with region HR.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Industrial Relations, or a related field required.
* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration (MBA), Organizational Development, or a related field is a plus
* Professional HR certification (SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR) preferred.

**Experience:**

* Eight + years of progressive more responsible Human Resources experience.
* Experience as primary HR lead in manufacturing, technology, or startup environments.
* Experience with site startups, workforce ramp-up, or high-growth operations strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in employee relations, talent acquisition, and HR compliance.
* Experience managing staffing agencies and contingent workforce programs.
* Strong working knowledge of federal, California state, and local employment laws, including wage and hour requirements, leave administration, workplace investigations, and employee relations best practices.
* Experience supporting customer audits, operational readiness activities, regulatory reviews, or compliance audits preferred

**Physical Demands & Working Conditions:**

The HR Generalist works in both office and production environments. The role requires the ability to sit, stand, walk, and move throughout the facility, with occasional lifting. jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:

Our managed inventory programs are designed to support manufacturing OEM’s with their engineered production material specifications, fulfillment, and quality requirements.

**Operations Manager Benefits****:** Gexpro Services offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* Competitive compensation plus annual bonus
* Medical, dental, vision, life insurance and pet insurance
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Employee assistance program and Health wellness programs
* 401(k) immediately with a competitive match
* Several paid holidays and paid time off that includes personal, sick and vacation time.

**Operations Manager Job Summary and Essential Responsibilities:**

The Operations Manager is responsible for driving operational performance, customer service, inventory accuracy, and execution across the site. This role provides leadership to operational teams, including the Warehouse Manager, and serves as the primary owner of operational results.

The Operations Manager is accountable for achieving service, productivity, inventory, quality, and cost objectives through effective leadership, cross-functional collaboration, performance management, and continuous improvement. jobs.title: Lab Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
Eikon Therapeutics is a new biopharmaceutical company employing revolutionary technology at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, computation, and biology to discover novel treatments for life-threatening diseases. Eikon's discovery platform is built on groundbreaking innovations from its founders (Nobel Prize, 2014), culminating in the creation of microscopes which enable real time, molecular-resolution measurements of protein movement in living cells, thereby unlocking otherwise intractable classes of proteins as drug targets.

**Position**  
As the Lab Ops Supervisor, you will oversee day-to-day operations of our chemistry labs, supervise 1 direct report (lab support technician), directly report to the Senior Director, and work closely with research teams to ensure optimal lab performance. You will be responsible for maintaining laboratory equipment, managing chemical inventory and solvent preparation, enforcing safety protocols, and fostering a collaborative work environment.

**About you**  
A highly organized and proactive professional with strong communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills. Able to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and effectively support laboratory operations and scientific teams. Adaptable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic research environment.

**What You'll Do:**

* Supervise and assist laboratory technicians by delegating tasks and regularly monitoring their progress to ensure the completion of assignments and the efficient use of resources.
* Carry out designated routine activities.
* Ensure the upkeep and calibration of laboratory equipment, guaranteeing its constant readiness for operation.
* Manage and track equipment inventory and equipment monitoring.
* Prepare and maintain solvent and reagent stock solutions to support daily lab operations.
* Maintain accurate chemical inventory, including tracking stock levels, expiration dates, proper labeling, and storage.
* Handle and coordinate the disposal of hazardous chemical waste in compliance with EPA, OSHA, and other applicable regulations.
* Manage procurement of lab supplies and chemicals, including vendor coordination and purchase orders.
* Enforce lab safety rules, hazardous material handling, and waste disposal practices.
* Develop and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for lab processes and safety protocols.
* Evaluate laboratory performance and advise on improvements to optimize efficiency.
* Promote teamwork, provide guidance, and help your team grow professionally.

This position requires participation in an on-call rotation for one week per month.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree with 2+ years of experience in a related scientific field (Biology, Chemistry, etc.).
* Bachelor's degree in Chemistry preferred.
* Proven leadership experience in a lab setting.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
* Good communication skills for working with your team and researchers.
* Knowledge of lab safety protocols and equipment handling.
* Comfortable using lab software and data analysis tools.
* A commitment to maintaining a safe and productive work environment.

At Eikon, employee compensation also includes bonus and equity compensation, in addition to several generous benefit programs, including:

* 401k plan with company matching
* Medical (premiums covered by Eikon at 95%), dental and vision insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%)
* Mental health and wellness benefits
* Weeklong summer and winter holiday shutdowns
* Generous paid time off and holiday policies
* Life/AD&D Insurance (premiums covered by Eikon at 100%) and optional supplemental employee-paid life/AD&D policies
* Enhanced parental leave benefit
* Daily subsidized lunch program when on-site

The expected salary range for this role is $95,000 to $105,000 depending on skills, competency, and the market demand for your expertise.

Eikon is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment.

We are currently not accepting any new third-party agencies or firms at this time. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our website, employees or Human Resources. Eikon Therapeutics will not pay fees to any third-party agency or firm associated with unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**What we do and why we do it**

As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting edge technology that transforms the way they do it.

**How it's going (and growing)**

With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of **Stessa** (financial and asset management software), **RentPrep** (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and **Mynd** (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in **Casago** (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.

**About the Role**

Roofstock is looking to hire an organized, systems-minded, and experienced Senior Legal Operations Manager to join our Legal team. This individual will own how legal work moves through the business: how it comes in, how it gets tracked, how it gets executed, and how it gets approved and paid. The Senior Legal Operations Manager will build durable workflows in place of institutional memory, keep contract turnaround predictable, maintain clean and complete records, support claims and litigation management in-house, and help manage outside counsel spend against budget. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad visibility, partnering closely with Finance, People Operations, Compliance, and the business teams that depend on Legal to move quickly.

### **Responsibilities**

**Legal Operations & Contract Management**

* Contract Lifecycle Management: Own end-to-end contract intake, routing, workflow optimization, and status tracking using Zip.
* First-Line Agreement Review: Perform initial triage and review of incoming third-party agreements in Zip, evaluating red flags, indemnification terms, and standard boilerplate before escalating complex issues to attorneys.
* Process & Self-Service Optimization: Build and maintain contract templates, playbooks, and self-service tools to empower business teams and eliminate attorney bottlenecks on routine agreements.
* Repository & Record Management: Establish repository standards (e.g., Google Drive structure) and manage post-execution filing and signature routing so critical legal records remain organized, current, and accessible.

**Financial Management & Outside Counsel Operations**

* Spend Management & Billing: Oversee law firm billing guidelines, manage outside counsel engagements, and perform initial invoice reviews.
* Finance & Accounting Alignment: Track legal spend against department budgets and collaborate directly with Accounting and Finance on monthly accruals, reporting, and operational friction points.
* Vendor Negotiations: Support rate negotiations with outside counsel and evaluate third-party legal vendors.

**Corporate Governance, Transactions & Claims (Paralegal Support)**

* Entity Management & Cap Table: Manage corporate governance, state filings, annual reports, and registered agent coordination across multiple entities and jurisdictions. Maintain cap table and corporate records in Carta.
* Transaction Support: Coordinate document collection, diligence request tracking, and virtual data room administration (e.g., DataSite) for corporate transactions and financings.
* Litigation & Claims Support: Support in-house claims and litigation intake, issue litigation holds, corporate insurance, coordinate document collection, track deadlines, and liaise with outside litigation counsel.

**Legal Technology & Department Analytics**

* System Administration: Directly administer legal tooling, including Zip (CLM), Carta, e-signature tools, and billing software.
* Reporting & Metrics: Build and maintain operational dashboards that track legal work volume, spend trends, and process bottlenecks for leadership.
* AI & Automation: Identify and implement emerging AI tools and automation to reduce manual workflows while maintaining appropriate review protocols.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of total experience in legal operations, contract management, or paralegal roles, with a strong core background (3+ years) in corporate paralegal responsibilities.
* Experience in a high-growth, late-stage private company (Series B/C/E) or proptech/fintech/real estate environment preferred (public company experience is not required).
* Solid working understanding of key contract terms (indemnification, liability, boilerplate provisions), corporate entity management across multiple jurisdictions, and litigation hold procedures.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
**Quality Assurance Manager****- Food Manufacturing**

Hayward, CA | Full-Time | 100% Onsite

  

**Job Description**

The Quality Assurance Manager will manage, coordinate, and implement quality assurance (QA) programs for plant operations. Monitor production, warehouse, maintenance  
and sanitation operations for adherence to quality and food safety programs. Monitor product conformance to quality specifications including complaint investigation and resolution

**This is a full-time, onsite position. Remote or hybrid work is not available.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, implement, and maintain the plant’s Food Safety Plan and HACCP program in compliance with the FDA’s food safety rule for manufacturers (FSMA, 21 CFR Part 117)

* Manage the SQF Food Safety Code program and lead preparation for the annual certification audit

* Serve as the primary contact for FDA, state, and local inspections and for customer and third-party audits, and manage all corrective actions

* Oversee the allergen control program, including cross-contact prevention, label checks, and validation of cleaning between product runs

* Partner with the Sanitation team to maintain cleaning schedules and written cleaning procedures, and to verify that equipment is clean before production starts

* Conduct internal GMP and food safety inspections across all shifts, and track findings until they are resolved

* Monitor finished products against quality specifications, and take part in taste and quality reviews and shelf-life testing

* Investigate consumer and customer complaints, find the root causes, and put fixes in place that prevent repeat problems, with a focus on preventing foreign objects in product

* Manage the approved supplier program, including incoming ingredient quality, supplier certificates and specifications, and handling of rejected materials

* Maintain traceability, product recall procedures, and plans to protect products from tampering and ingredient fraud, and run mock recalls at least once a year

* Provide technical support to co-packers and suppliers, including reviews of their allergen and HACCP plans

* Set and report on food safety and quality performance measures to senior leadership

* Deliver GMP, food safety, allergen, and sanitation training to new and current associates, and keep training records up to date

* Lead, coach, and develop the QA team, and support Lean and continuous improvement work across the plant

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Biology, Chemistry, or a related field

* Minimum of 5 years of quality assurance experience in food manufacturing, including at least 2 years in a supervisory or management role

* Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI) and HACCP certifications required

* SQF Practitioner certification required, or ability to obtain it within 90 days of hire

* In-depth knowledge of FSMA, GMPs, allergen management, sanitation programs, and GFSI-recognized food safety standards

* Proven experience leading SQF or other GFSI certification audits and regulatory inspections

* Experience in bakery  
  or high-speed packaged food production preferred

* Strong English communication skills, written and verbal. Fluency in Spanish strongly preferred

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, and familiarity with quality, ERP and timekeeping systems

  

**Key Attributes**

* Puts consumer safety first and makes sound decisions, even under pressure

* Stays calm and decisive during audits, deviations, and investigations

* Pays close attention to detail and uses data to solve problems

* Leads visibly on the production floor and earns trust across all shifts

  

**Work Environment**  
The role involves regular work on the production floor, including hot, cold, wet, and noisy areas. Candidates must follow all PPE and hygiene requirements, be able to lift up to 50 lbs, and be flexible to cover multiple shifts as needed.

  

Wisoman Foods Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

**Why work for us?**

* Opportunity to contribute to a growing, mission-driven food company.

* Work closely with a collaborative, passionate team.

* Gain hands-on experience in all aspects of procurement and sourcing in the specialty food sector.
* Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision
* Paid Holidays
* PTO (Vacation and Sick)

Sunrise is a thriving event venue located in Vacaville, CA. We host a wide variety of events ranging from Weddings & Quinceaneras to Corporate Meetings & Community Galas.

jobs.title: Immigration Program Manager (Operations)
jobs.description:
SummaryMeta is seeking an operations manager within its immigration program to lead the operating model for complex Talent Acquisition programs and the processes recruiting runs on. This person decides where the function should invest its process and program effort, sets the standards that recruiting teams work to, and carries the judgment calls on compliance risk, standardization, and sequencing. They will work from hiring priorities rather than defined project briefs, and they are accountable for outcomes across a stakeholder set they do not manage.The role also carries functional ownership of Meta's PERM recruitment process: a specialized, compliance-critical domain where this person is the company's internal authority on process and operations. We are looking for an experienced TA program and process owner who can hold that compliance line. Deep PERM expertise is valuable but can be built with support from the Immigration team and outside counsel.  
  
  

### **Immigration Program Manager (Operations) Responsibilities:**

* Portfolio and Operating Model Ownership
* Define, plan and execute complex TA programs and cross-functional initiatives. Identify which problems are worth solving, make the case for them, and sequence them against hiring priorities and capacity
* Set the operating model for how TA programs are scoped, governed, launched, and transitioned to steady state, and hold teams to it
* Own the relationship with outside counsel on PERM matters, setting the agenda on program-level strategy and taking a position on individual case strategy rather than relaying it
* Define the roles, responsibilities, and controls within the PERM recruitment process, then build the processes that drive sustained adherence across TA, Hiring Managers, and TA Operations
* Set the direction for the PERM Recruitment Enhancement initiative, including scope, risk appetite, and the standard the redesigned process must meet
* Serve as function manager for Meta's Talent Center PERM recruitment process, owning process health, compliance posture, and outcomes
* PERM Recruitment Program Ownership
* Initiate permanent residence cases with outside counsel and manage case progression against filing timelines
* Own the documentation standard for PERM (immigrant visa) filings, and ensure the process remains audit-ready by design rather than by remediation
* Act as the internal authority and escalation point for the Immigration team, foreign national employees, and HR partners on PERM questions
* Translate ambiguous or competing hiring priorities into a multi-quarter roadmap, and make the trade-off calls when priorities conflict
* Own the measures of success for the portfolio, including clearly defined success criteria and performance benchmarks
* Build mechanisms that let programs run without you: clear ownership, documentation, performance measures, and review cadence
* Process Architecture and Operational Excellence
* Own the end-to-end design of priority TA processes: workforce demand intake, requisition launch, sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, offer management, preboarding, and recruiting operations
* Decide where processes should be standardized in ways that improve speed, quality, consistency and compliance and be able to defend those decisions to stakeholders
* Diagnose root causes behind systemic process failure rather than individual bottlenecks, and distinguish problems worth fixing from noise
* Set decision rights, handoffs, service expectations, escalation paths, and operating mechanisms across recruiting teams, including where those boundaries sit with Finance, Legal, and IT
* Establish the playbooks, SOPs, and governance practices that become the reference standard for recruiting execution
* Define the requirements that recruiting technology and ATS workflows must meet, and hold systems partners to them
* Build the data and feedback mechanisms that make continuous improvement a property of the function rather than a project activity
* Influence and Stakeholder Leadership
* Advise TA and business leaders on process and program strategy, including when their stated ask is not the right one
* Drive accountability across recruiters, coordinators, sourcers, hiring managers, interviewers, systems teams, Finance, Legal, and IT without direct authority
* Resolve contested design decisions across concurrent workstreams, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a question
* Raise the capability of other program and operations practitioners through mentoring, review, and reusable standards

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Track record of owning a program or process domain end to end as the accountable individual
* Experience setting direction in ambiguity: defining the problem, building the case for investment, and sequencing work against competing priorities
* Experience designing operational processes that were adopted beyond the team that built them, with measurable improvement

**Hi, Future Homie!**

At Homebase, you’ll join a team that’s bold, fast-moving, and obsessed with helping small businesses thrive. We build with empathy, act with urgency, and take big swings that drive real-world impact. Here, every Homie shows up to raise the bar, support one another, and celebrate wins as a team.

We’re not just building an app—we’re building unstoppable teams. So what do you say, are you in?  
  
**Your impact starts here**

As our **Senior Marketing Operations Manager**, you will make sure marketers get the data they need quickly and reliably, in a form they can use.

You will work daily with Growth, Lifecycle, Analytics, Data Engineering, and Product, and you will be someone both marketers and engineers want to work with.

This is a hands-on, technical role for a builder who is comfortable with integration work and uses AI to change how work gets done.

**What you'll own**

**Marketing data access**

* Understand what data every marketer needs, where it lives, and where the gaps are, and be the front door for getting it delivered quickly.
* Build self-serve paths for common needs such as segments and audiences, and test implementations end to end with Lifecycle and Engineering.

**Pipelines and integrations**

* Build and maintain data flows between our product and data systems and our marketing and ad tools (Iterable, Amplitude, Salesforce, Meta CAPI, Google Ads, Apple Search Ads), including conversion signal quality, identity resolution, and deduplication.
* Partner with RevOps on Salesforce, sending marketing data in and bringing key events back.

**Monitoring, quality, and documentation**

* Monitor key data flows and catch problems before marketers do. Make sure the data feeding attribution is accurate. You will not build the attribution model.
* Own data governance and documentation: definitions, naming, UTM standards, playbooks, and intake processes.

**Marketing systems and enablement**

* Serve as technical owner of the marketing stack, resolve lifecycle and advertising requests directly, and implement tags for new channels and partners.

**Project ownership and partnership**

* Own projects end to end, plan ahead with Lifecycle so Engineering inputs are identified early, and recommend simplifying redundant tools as our stack evolves.
* Use AI for documentation, QA, anomaly detection, and workflow automation.

**The foundation for success**

* 5 to 8 years in marketing operations, marketing technology, go-to-market engineering, or marketing data roles.
* A track record of building the connectors, pipelines, or processes that make product and engineering data usable by marketing.
* Strong SQL and comfort with APIs, webhooks, and event schemas. Scripting (Python or JavaScript) is a plus.
* Range across lifecycle and automation tools (for example Iterable, Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, or Marketo), event or CDP tools (Amplitude, Segment, or similar), and a data warehouse. We value breadth over deep expertise in a single vendor. Familiarity with Salesforce.
* Working knowledge of pixels, tags, UTMs, ad platform conversion APIs, and identity resolution.
* AI fluency: you use AI in real work, or can clearly describe how you would apply it and verify the result.
* A strong collaborator who can translate between technical and non-technical colleagues, and who builds trust with both.
* A self-starter who has inherited a messy environment, made a plan, and executed without waiting to be told what to do.

**Nice to have:** paid acquisition data experience, exposure to Hotjar or AI search visibility tools such as Profound, and a go-to-market engineering background.

**This role is probably not for you if**

* You are looking for a clean, fully documented environment and a large team around you from day one.
* Your strength is building and launching campaigns. This role is about the data and systems underneath them.
* You prefer to hand off technical work and manage others rather than build it yourself. We need a doer right now.

**What you'll gain**

* Ownership of a mission-critical data and systems layer that every marketer depends on.
* Visibility across the go-to-market organization and a real say in how we scale.

**The Homie Way -** These principles guide everything we do—from how we work and make decisions to how we show up for each other.

* **Be Customer Obsessed** – Solve problems with empathy and creativity.
* **Move Fast, Learn Fast** – Experiment, take action, and grow every day.
* **Own Your Impact** – Think big, focus on what matters, and make decisions you stand behind.
* **Master Your Craft** – Excellence fuels impact—show up, step up, and make your mark.
* **Win Together** – Put goals over roles, lead with trust, and connect to our mission and each other.

* Ownership & Financial Security: Stock options + 401(k) with 4% match
* Comprehensive Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision coverage + FSA options
* Paid Time Off: Flexible PTO + company holidays + designated focus periods
* AI access, for real: We invest in builders and believe that curiosity shouldn't have a paywall. That means you'll have access to paid AI tools with minimal restrictions, so you can build, experiment, and level up your craft.
* Family Support: Up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave (after 6 months of service)
* Protection Plans: Life insurance + short/long-term disability coverage
* Work Your Way: Work From Anywhere Month + meeting-free weeks yearly

jobs.description:
RingCentral is looking for an HCM Program Manager to drive delivery of our Human Capital Management initiatives, from new module rollouts to upgrades, integrations, and process improvements. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll be the hands-on owner who keeps HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and our HCM vendor aligned and moving, and who makes sure what we launch actually gets adopted.  
This is an in-house role. You won't be handing off to a client at go-live; you'll live with the platform and keep making it better. Reports to [Hiring Manager Title, e.g. Director of HR Technology / HRIS Manager].  
What you'll do

* Drive end-to-end delivery of HCM initiatives, including module implementations (Payroll, Time & Attendance, Benefits, Talent, Recruiting), upgrades, and vendor releases
* Build and maintain integrated plans across related workstreams, tracking timelines, dependencies, risks, and budget
* Run the operating rhythm: status reporting, working sessions, and steering committee updates for HR, Finance, and IT leadership
* Gather requirements from HR, Payroll, and business partners and translate them into clear scope, configuration needs, and success criteria
* Partner day-to-day with the HCM vendor and implementation partner, holding them to scope, timelines, and SOW commitments
* Coordinate integrations with adjacent systems such as ERP/GL, benefits carriers, LMS, ATS, and identity management
* Own testing and data migration execution, including end-to-end, parallel payroll, and user acceptance testing
* Lead change management, training, and communications so employees, managers, and HR teams adopt new processes
* Plan and run cutovers and go-lives, then manage hypercare and transition to ongoing support
* Surface risks early, escalate with options, and contribute to the HCM roadmap based on what you learn after launch

What you bring  
**Required**

* 5+ years of project or program management experience
* Hands-on experience driving at least one full-cycle HCM implementation on a platform such as UKG, ADP, Dayforce, Workday, Oracle, or SuccessFactors
* Working knowledge of core HR processes: hire-to-retire, payroll, time and attendance, benefits, and compensation
* Experience managing vendors and implementation partners against scope and SOW commitments
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through influence, without direct authority
* Strong command of project management tools and methods (Smartsheet, Jira, MS Project, or similar; Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid)
* Comfort handling sensitive employee data and working within privacy and compliance requirements
* Clear, confident communicator who can brief leadership and run a working session with equal ease

**Nice to have**

* PMP, CSM, or equivalent certification
* Platform certification (e.g., UKG Pro, ADP Workforce Now, Dayforce)
* Multi-state or international payroll experience
* Background in change management (Prosci or similar)

-----------------

At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." UX Programs & Operations drives projects by increasing communication, streamlining the UX design process, and fostering a culture of user-centered development. You will join our multi-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, to create industry-leading products based on user insights.  
  
As a UX Program Manager, you will combine expert project management with a passion for user experience to improve the design of products used by billions. You will independently develop and execute plans for end-to-end UX programs of moderate complexity, balancing big-picture product goals with day-to-day operational execution. By combining working knowledge of UX craft, research methodologies, and modern AI-enabled workflows, you will spot cross-project patterns, proactively mitigate risks, and create the conditions for UXers to do their best work at scale.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

The Value Optimization PM is the business owner of process intelligence: the requirements, the KPIs, the initiative pipeline, and the value realized. * 7 or more years in procurement, source to pay, finance, or process transformation, including program or portfolio management of cross functional initiatives.
* Experience owning KPI frameworks, baselining, and cost or value methodology, with the ability to reconcile operational data against finance.
* Working knowledge of process mining and analytics (Celonis a plus) and of S2P systems such as SAP and Ariba, with the ability to translate business needs into technical requirements.
* Proven ability to influence and govern across teams and to drive initiatives to measured value without direct authority over delivery teams.
* Experience communicating at the executive and steering committee level across a global organization.
* Familiarity with AI and agentic automation concepts and their operational and cost implications a plus.

The Port of San Francisco is an enterprise agency of the City and County of San Francisco and is governed by a Commission of five members appointed by the Mayor. The Port Commission is responsible for overseeing a broad range of waterfront commercial, maritime, and public access facilities that are held in public trust for the people of California. The Port’s jurisdiction covers approximately 7.5 miles of waterfront land from Pier 98, near Hunter’s Point in the southern part of San Francisco, to Fisherman’s Wharf in the northern part of the City.  
  
The Port’s diverse business portfolio includes over 550 ground, commercial, retail, office, industrial and maritime industrial leases including cargo shipping, layberthing, excursion boats, ferry boats, fishing and fish processing/distribution, tourism, filming, harbor services, and cruise operations. jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
When you care deeply about the work you do, it’s rewarding to see it through from concept to completion. We partner with clients to provide both program management and construction management to strategize, plan, and implement projects that drive organizations forward. From hospitals and airports to university campuses, mass transit systems, water treatment facilities, mines, and wind farms, we've successfully managed thousands of projects.

Joining our team, turning visionary ideas into reality, will shape your future—and the future of your community.

We are strategizing, planning, and implementing projects that help clients achieve their organization’s objectives. Join our award-winning program management team and bring transformational project solutions to life.

Your Opportunity

As a Program Manager in Stantec you will lead a team and ensure adherence to the mission and objectives of the assigned program. You will have leadership responsibility for an integrated program team composed of both client and consultant staff. Duties of the Program Manager include client coordination, providing day-to-day guidance to multi-disciplined teams in a co-located Program Management Office (PMO) environment, typically located at a client facility. You will assist owners/clients with execution of the program, addressing strategy and delivery challenges and supporting internal client departments as may be required. You will oversee implementation of program delivery procedures and processes and confirm the program team’s performance against stated objectives.

The Program Manager oversees all services provided by an integrated team, including but not limited to: general program and project management services (scheduling, cost controls, risk management, change management, document control, interface management, engineering management etc.), preliminary design, subject matter expert technical support on projects, regulatory and permitting support, technical studies to support planning and design efforts, procurement of design and construction, construction management, operations & maintenance liaison, operations and maintenance readiness, community outreach and communications, project and program delivery strategy, funding strategy and training/knowledge transfer.

The Program Manager is responsible to track and manage delivery performance (cost, schedule, quality) on each project and the overall program.

Your Key Responsibilities

* Advising and assisting the client in the development, management, and execution of the program.
* Leading and overseeing the work of a multi-disciplinary client, consultant, and sub-consultant team.
* Serving as a trusted advisor to the client and working as part of an integrated Client/Consultant Leadership Team.
* Overseeing the effective mobilization and set-up of the program in conjunction with the Stantec Mobilization Manager.
* Implementation of a robust governance structure to ensure adherence to a rigorous approach to project and program management.
* Implementation of program methodologies for project evaluation and selection of appropriate delivery models.
* Establishment of a performance reporting framework including the development of key performance indicators and associated reports/dashboards.
* Pro-actively identifying client needs and programmatic initiatives required to address potential program delivery risks and challenges.
* Assisting the client in development of its staff through implementation of best practices, training classes and knowledge transfer.
* Developing, negotiating, and managing consultant services authorizations for program management services.
* Overseeing administration of the management consultant services contract including management of change orders, amendments, task order renewals, and invoicing working with Stantec Finance and Accounting support staff.
* Compliance with all Stantec internal processes and procedures including preparation of reports and other deliverables as required by internal delivery governance requirements.
* Preparing or overseeing preparation of reports and other deliverables defined in the contract scope of services.
* Management of subconsultants, including negotiating of subcontract agreements, review of invoices, and compliance with any Diverse, Local, and Small Business Enterprise requirements by the client.
* Reviewing consultant and contractor submittals including technical and contractual documents.
* Providing programmatic and technical support related to client governing bodies and various other departments.

Your Capabilities and Credentials

* Must be able to demonstrate strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work in a team environment.
* Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to convey program and project delivery needs to the client and to formulate those needs into comprehensive proposals.
* Must demonstrate organizational skills and ability to work on multiple projects and activities simultaneously.
* The position involves work associated with critical infrastructure; therefore, a client background check is required.
* Strong technical understanding of water and wastewater utility infrastructure, organizations and processes required.
* Knowledgeable in relevant areas of pre-construction and construction including understanding of various design and construction contracting methods and processes.
* Experience supporting sales processes for acquisition of new program opportunities and startup of new capital infrastructure programs is desirable.

Education and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, or related field required
* 20+ years experience in the delivery of water/wastewater projects/programs.
* 10+ years leading large water/wastewater programs ($1B or higher) with a large construction management element featuring traditional and collaborative delivery methods.
* MS in Engineering or MBA
* PMP / PgMP (PMI)
*

jobs.title: Home care Case Manager / Client care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Make a Difference Every Day!**

At Home Helpers of Santa Clara Valley, we believe everyone deserves to live safely, comfortably, and independently in the place they call home. We are looking for a compassionate, proactive, and highly organized **Client Care Coordinator** to join our team and help ensure exceptional care and service for our clients and their families.

This position is ideal for a professional with experience in home care, healthcare coordination, or case management who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, coordinating services, and making a meaningful difference in the lives of older adults and individuals with disabilities.

The Client Care Coordinator will oversee the client care process from the initial assessment and development of individualized service plans through ongoing monitoring, quality assurance, and client relationship management. The role requires a combination of office-based coordination, client and family communication, and regular field visits.

**Candidates with previous home care or healthcare care-coordination experience are strongly encouraged to apply.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Client Assessments and Care Planning**

* Conduct initial in-home assessments to evaluate clients' needs, preferences, living environments, and safety concerns.
* Develop individualized, written service plans that reflect each client's needs, goals, preferences, and authorized non-medical services.
* Conduct reassessments and update service plans as client conditions, preferences, or circumstances change.
* Ensure intake paperwork, service agreements, and required documentation are completed before services begin.

**2. Client and Family Relationship Management**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, families, and authorized representatives regarding care coordination and service-related questions.
* Conduct regular quality assurance calls and in-home visits to assess client satisfaction and the effectiveness of services.
* Review caregiver visit notes and communicate with caregivers and families to identify changes in client needs or concerns.
* Address client complaints and service concerns promptly, document all communications, and coordinate appropriate follow-up and resolution.
* Build trust with clients and families through proactive communication, responsiveness, and compassionate service.

**3. Caregiver Coordination and Service Quality**

* Partner with the Staffing Coordinator to match clients with caregivers based on client needs, preferences, schedules, and caregiver qualifications.
* Communicate client-specific needs, service plan expectations, household preferences, and safety considerations to assigned caregivers.
* Review caregiver daily visit notes and identify concerns, missed tasks, or changes that may require follow-up.
* Collaborate with the staffing team to monitor Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) exceptions, including missed clock-ins, late arrivals, and other scheduling concerns.
* Help coordinate emergency coverage and communicate service changes to minimize interruptions in care.
* Reinforce appropriate non-medical care boundaries and agency policies, including medication reminders rather than medication administration, as applicable to the authorized service plan.

**4. Compliance, Documentation, and Quality Assurance**

* Maintain accurate, timely, and complete client records, assessments, service plans, visit notes, incident reports, and communication logs in the agency's care management system.
* Ensure documentation and client care practices comply with applicable California Department of Social Services (CDSS) requirements, HIPAA privacy requirements, Joint Commission standards, and agency policies.
* Identify potential safety risks, service concerns, or changes in client condition and escalate them to the appropriate team members.
* Support internal quality assurance initiatives, record reviews, audits, and continuous improvement efforts.
* Protect confidential client information and follow established privacy and security procedures.

jobs.description:

The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in financial operations and data analytics, combined with excellent stakeholder communication skills and practical experience leveraging AI and automation to streamline business processes.

jobs.description:
SI-BONE is a fast-growing, publicly traded medical device company that is an industry pioneer in minimally invasive sacropelvic solutions. Our mission is to help patients rise up and reach for the stars, and our vision is to work together as the global leader to make sacropelvic conditions universally recognized and effectively treated through innovation, evidence, education, and advocacy.

SI-BONE® is focused on helping patients in one of the most under-served, under-diagnosed, and under-treated areas in orthopedics, the sacroiliac (SI) joint. SI-BONE developed an innovative, patented implant to fuse the SI joint. The iFuse Implant System® provides a less invasive alternative to traditional sacroiliac (SI) joint fusion surgery and has been used in over 90,000 procedures to date.

We are a medical device company that is focused on improving the lives of patients with sacroiliac pelvic conditions. We are looking for people who are passionate about our mission and who are willing to work hard to achieve it. We are also looking for people who are:

Midi is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Patient Experience to own the digital experience that helps women build a long-term relationship with Midi. Our goal is to be a patient's healthcare home, supporting more of her care needs both in and outside of telehealth visits. This role will shape the journey from the first visit and onward: how patients stay engaged, return for follow-up care, and discover the other ways Midi can support them. * **Own the Patient Experience Roadmap:** Define the vision and roadmap for the web experience patients use across their care journey, from onboarding and visit preparation through follow-up care and long-term support. Set clear targets for engagement and retention, and prioritize the bets most likely to reach them.

* **Focus on Patient LTV:** A strong understanding of how onboarding, ongoing engagement, and lifecycle communication shape retention, repeat usage, and lifetime value. You are motivated by helping patients build a lasting relationship with Midi.
* **High-Agency Problem Solver:** An action-oriented, ownership mindset with the ability to break complex challenges into simple, scalable solutions in a fast-paced environment.

**Company Overview**  
For more than 50 years, Insight Housing (formerly BFHP) has provided a comprehensive range of housing, food, and support services to help those in need move from homelessness into a safe and affordable home of their own. We serve in seven counties in the Bay Area - Alameda County, San Francisco County, Contra Costa County, Solano County, Sacramento County, San Joaquin County, and Amador County. We are proud of our team members who are very dedicated in our mission *to ensure everyone in our community has a home through supportive, equitable, and sustainable housing solutions.*

**Program Description**

Insight Housing’s VA Grants per Diem Program, Going Home – Berkeley Vets (GHB) is an innovative low demand/low barrier transitional housing services program. Veterans receive intensive case management, are linked to the medical and mental health capabilities of the VA, and are assisted with obtaining an income and housing.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst, User Safety & Risk Operations
jobs.description:
Trust & Safety - San Francisco

**About the Team**

At OpenAIs of misuse. We translate real-world user and operational signals into timely decisions, practical interventions, and improvements to our products and systems.

This role will take on new, ambiguous, or underdeveloped operational risks and help mature them into scalable capabilities. We work across USRO and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Policy, Legal, Safety, Support, and external vendors or partnership stakeholders.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Senior Operations Analyst to take on complex, ambiguous safety and risk problems and turn them into practical operational solutions that can scale. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a versatile operator who is comfortable moving between queues, investigation, analysis, workflow design, hands-on execution, and cross-functional leadership. Depending on team needs, the role may focus on emerging-risk incubation, cloud deployment partnerships, or other new operational areas.

You will be expected to move quickly, work hands-on, and create structure without waiting for perfect requirements or a large support team. The work starts with the problem, not a prescribed process. You may investigate unstructured user signals, stand up a lightweight workflow, build an AI-assisted tool, improve an existing operation, or help a new launch become operationally ready. The goal is to produce durable systems that other people can run, not simply complete a series of individual tasks.

The portfolio will change with company priorities and may span established harm areas, emerging-risk incubation, cloud deployments and partnerships, device safety, or new product launches. Some hires may focus primarily on cloud deployment operations, including launch readiness, partner coordination, safety workflows, and operational monitoring. You will typically own a small number of high-impact problems at a time and will be expected to judge what needs to be built, what can stay lightweight, and when the work is ready to scale, transfer, or stop.

Location / work model: San Francisco, CA; hybrid, 3 days/week in-office.

***Please note:*** *This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. Strong discretion, good judgment, and resilience are essential.*

**In This Role, You Will**

* Take ownership of ambiguous, high-priority safety and risk problems: define the problem, gather the right evidence, choose a practical path, drive execution, and close the loop.
* Analyze structured and unstructured data, both quantitative and qualitative. This may include user reports, case narratives, conversations, escalations, and operational metrics to identify patterns, risks, and the highest-leverage interventions.
* Build and test lightweight workflows, tools, automations, and decision aids that improve speed, quality, and consistency, then iterate based on real-world use.
* Turn one-off insights and manual work into scalable operating mechanisms without adding unnecessary process or complexity.
* Lead sensitive investigations, incident response, or launch-readiness work, including safety workflows, human review, escalation paths, partner coordination, and operational monitoring for product launches or cloud deployments.
* Work directly with cross-functional and external partners to clarify ownership, resolve operational gaps, and turn incomplete signals into clear recommendations and decisions.
* Measure whether the work is improving outcomes—such as quality, speed, coverage, operator effort, or risk reduction—and adjust quickly when it is not.
* Help junior operators build judgment and independence through coaching, calibration, and reusable tools.

**You Might Thrive in This Role If You**

* Have 8+ years of experience in trust and safety operations, investigations, incident response, product operations, technical program management, or another high-judgment, data-heavy operational field.
* Have a track record as a scrappy generalist who can enter an unfamiliar problem, learn quickly, and deliver with limited structure or support.
* Are highly data savvyation and combine it with quantitative evidence.
* Are technically fluent and hands-on with AI tools, dashboards, and data tooling, and can build or prototype practical solutions without waiting for a dedicated technical team.
* Operate independently, make clear tradeoffs, and maintain momentum as priorities and requirements change.
* Think in systems: you look beyond the immediate task and build approaches that can be repeated, measured, and operated by others.
* Exercise strong judgment in sensitive situations involving user impact, policy, legal risk, technical constraints, and business priorities.
* Communicate clearly and directlyal authority.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in trust and safety, fraud, product safety, integrity, or another adversarial or high-severity risk domain.
* Experience moving a new or immature workflow from early investigation into stable, scaled operations.
* Experience supporting cloud platforms or deployment partnerships, enterprise products, product launches, connected devices, or other technically complex programs. Direct cloud experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* Familiarity with SQL, lightweight scripting, no-code tools, workflow automation, or AI-assisted development.
* Experience with vendor operations, quality programs, calibrations, or distributed operational teams.

**About OpenAI**

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is building the safety capability for autonomous mobility. As Program Manager, AV Safety Policy & Programs, you'll own key parts of Lyft's AV Safety Management System (SMS) across all four pillars: Safety Policy, Safety Risk Management, Safety Assurance, and Safety Promotion. You'll also make sure the processes, documentation, and cross-functional machinery behind them work in practice.

This is a high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of safety policy, program design, and cross-functional process support. You'll author policy, run risk and review cadences, turn safety data into decisions, and keep the Safety Review Board (SRB) running. You'll work closely with AV partners, and you can speak credibly about AV safety with technical counterparts, senior leaders, and external partners.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Safety Policy:** Own Lyft's AV safety policy framework, safety procedures, and partner-facing governance documentation, including version control and periodic review cycles. Maintain governance charters, committee operating rhythms, and escalation protocols.
* **Safety Risk Management:** Run hazard identification and risk assessment for AV operations and new launches. Maintain the operational risk register and track mitigations to closure.
* **Safety Assurance:** Track safety performance indicators and trends, and surface emerging risks. Participate in incident and near-miss investigations and own corrective action (CAPA) tracking, so findings feed back into policy, operations, and partner work plans. Coordinate evidence and remediation for audits and certifications.

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, Energy Storage
jobs.description:
**About Redwood Materials**

**Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.**

**Position Summary:**

The Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, Energy Storage is a career-level individual contributor role that owns program management across all commodities supporting the Energy Storage business. The role builds and maintains the integrated supply chain schedule across commodity owners, suppliers, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Finance, tracks supplier milestones and risks, and drives material readiness for new product introduction builds and production ramp. The role works independently and is reviewed at critical points. This is a fully on-site role in our San Francisco R&D space, with approximately 10% international travel to supplier sites.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead the integrated supply chain program plan across all Energy Storage commodities (for example, electronics PCBAs, mechanical components, energy equipment, solar panels, and harnesses), tracking milestones, dependencies, and resources across suppliers and internal teams
* Serve as the liaison between Supply Chain commodity teams and Programs, Engineering, Manufacturing, Finance, and leadership, communicating program status, key milestones, and risks
* Identify supply and schedule risks early, and devise and drive mitigation plans with commodity owners and suppliers
* Coordinate supplier readiness for new product introduction builds and production ramp, including capacity, qualification, and delivery plans
* Track supply chain program metrics (cost, lead time, delivery performance, inventory) across commodities and report results to leadership
* Resolve cross-functional issues and escalations that affect program schedule, cost, or quality
* Develop and improve program management tools, templates, and processes for supply chain programs

**Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of program management, supply chain, or sourcing experience (3+ years with a Master's degree), ideally in energy storage, battery, EV, or electronics manufacturing
* Working knowledge of new product introduction, production ramp, and supply chain operations across electronic, mechanical, and electromechanical commodities
* Experience building and managing integrated schedules, milestone trackers, and risk registers across multiple stakeholders and commodity teams
* Ability to analyze supply chain data (cost, lead time, delivery, inventory) to identify trends and risks
* Ability to communicate program status and risks clearly, in writing and verbally, to cross-functional partners and leadership
* Ability to travel internationally to supplier sites approximately 10% of the time

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

  

We collect personal information (PI) from you in connection with your application for employment with Redwood Materials, including the following categories of PI: identifiers, personal records, professional or employment information, and inferences drawn from your PI. We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

* **Win together.** Partner with Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and other teams to create a seamless customer experience and unlock new growth opportunities.
