**Job Summary & Scope:**

Drive the sales of service programs/products to meet/exceed customer needs as well as drive revenue.

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Drive the sale of service programs, to meet/exceed sales and margin goals.
* Use existing customer base and new lead information to develop and increase the sales of service offerings.
* Work as an individual team member, to meet/exceed individual and/or team service sales targets and goals.
* Track and manage sales opportunities from lead to finalization of service contracts.
* Facilitate proper quoting, positioning, promoting and selling of services to ensure high close rates.
* Ensure accurate forecasting, account planning, and reports are maintained and submitted on a weekly, monthly and quarterly basis.
* Build and maintain long-term customer retention and relationships by researching and developing existing customers, as well as new leads.
* Responsible for assigned accounts but may be required to transition accounts to other sales teams/business segments as determined.
* Ensure a strategic, "One Peak" mindset – managing accounts and business priorities.
* Work closely with various Sales Leadership.
* Establish and maintain good business relations with customers and external contacts, including our partner community.
* Maintain effective working relationships, communication, and coordination with all co-workers, and leadership.

**Education + Experience + Key Traits:**

* Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from four-year college or university; up to 5 years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* **Competencies:** Sales Management, organizational development skills and competencies.
* AIDC sales experience is highly desired.

**Typical Performance Targets:**

* **Service Delivery:** Sustained, measured excellence in project & process delivery.
* **Cost To Serve:** Sustained, measured excellence in delivery efficiency with expected continuous improvement.
* **Innovation:** Step changed delivery in safety, quality, and/or cost.

**Language Skills:**

* Primary language used in daily operations is English.
* Read and interpret documents, procedure manuals and various correspondence from both internal and external.
* Speak effectively, both individually and before groups of both external customers and/or various levels of employees within the organization.

**Supervision:**

* Role is not responsible for supervising direct or indirect reports.

**Decision Making + Reasoning:**

Able to take accountability and responsibility for business target delivery and decision making.  

  

**Mathematical Skills:**

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**Reasoning Ability:**

* Define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
* Ability to follow detailed instructions and utilize existing resources to solve problems.

**Working Relationships:**

* Peak Senior Management Team.
* Key Customer Sr. Leadership.
* Key Vendor Sr. Leadership.

**Computer Skills:**

* To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of Excel Spreadsheet software, Word Processing, and PowerPoint presentation software. CRM skills required.

jobs.description:
**SEIU UHW-West & Joint Employer Education Fund Position Description**
======================================================================

**Job Title:** Implementation Specialist **Classification:** Exempt **Department:** Education

**Reports to:** Assistant Director of Programs

**Location:** Oakland or Los Angeles

**SEIU UHW-West & Joint Employer Education** **Fund**
=====================================================

The Education Fund is a non-profit partnership between 6 Locals of the Service Employees International Union (SEIU) and 22 Healthcare Industry employers, serving the education and training needs of 100,000 eligible workers. Our mission is to empower our diverse healthcare workforce to advance in a changing environment through innovative education and training solutions. Our program and budget have doubled in scale over the last five years to provide career advancement and continuing education services to 20,000 learners annually, and we are positioned for continued growth with new partners and funding.

**Principal Purpose of Job:** Plans and coordinates implementation of education and training programs for healthcare workers represented by SEIU UHW-West and other union members who are eligible for Education Fund services.

**Level of Authority:** Performs duties independently and in conjunction with a team, setting priorities and scheduling own work under the general direction of the assistant director or program manager and in accordance with organizational policies and procedures

**Work Environment:** Work is performed in a complex setting both inside, and outside of the office, with frequent adjustments and the need to deal with a diversity of people and tasks. Position requires frequent visits to external collaborators and students, in addition to travel to training locations, some of which may include overnight trips.

**Essential Job** **Functions:**
================================

* Own data processing, validation and reporting for assigned programs
* Develops and maintains good relationships with educational vendors
* Owns document creation and maintenance for programs, including SOP’s, Program
* Overviews, Program Guides, Procedure Guides and Salesforce document library.
* Closeout enrollments, including completing sanctions, reporting outcomes and rollovers.
* Grants team: database management for grant reporting, special documentation
* Coordinates monthly provider meetings to request program enrollments and progress reports.
* Partners with PDS for program-specific needs and tasks.
* Submits regular written reports and ensures compliance with program requirements and goals.
* Work in conjunction with the program coordinator/ Regional coordinator, assisting with the implementation of programs and projects, including planning, developing, implementing, and evaluating programs and projects.
* Performs other tasks and responsibilities as assigned by the assistant director or director of the program

**Additional Job** **Functions**
================================

* May work with internal/external staff to conduct a survey of learners' academic readiness and/or skills using digital survey tools.
* May assist with recruiting participants for and facilitating worker committees set up to promote the Education Fund's work.
* Bring forth ideas that provide insight into our department, professional development of the staff, and positive health of the team.

**Qualifications****and****Capabilities**
=========================================

* Minimum of one-year experience planning and implementing educational or training programs preferred.
* Proficient use of basic Microsoft Suite, Salesforce, or other CRM systems.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience within a union and/or healthcare environment preferred.
* Must be committed to working within a labor-management partnership environment.
* Familiarity with project management concepts
* Strong leadership, critical thinking, coordination, and organizational skills are necessary.
* Flexibility regarding schedule and assignments
* Ability to work well as part of a team
* Professional demeanor with the ability to create rapport with a diverse group of members and partners
* An automobile, California driver’s license, and auto insurance are also required.

**Physical** **Demands:**
=========================

* Ability to drive and move from one site to another for extended periods of time.
* Ability to sit at a workstation for extended time periods.
* Occasional ability to lift, and carry equipment or packages weighing up to 35 pounds

**Other**
=========

The statements contained in this job description reflect general details necessary to describe the principal functions of this position, level of knowledge, the skill typically required, and the scope of responsibility. It should not be considered an all-inclusive listing of work requirements.

Individuals may perform other duties as assigned, including work in other functional areas to cover absences or as needed.

All offers of employment are contingent upon satisfactory background checks.

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
### **About AppLovin**

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com.

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

### **About the Role**

We are seeking a smart, hardworking Business Operations Analyst to provide technical and operational support to our Business Operations (BizOps) team and the systems supporting our mobile-advertising business.

A central part of this role is helping other BizOps analysts deliver reliable projects. You will review their code, debug existing workflows, investigate product issues, and translate business problems into actionable requests for Engineering and Operations. You will also write and maintain your own workflow code and analyze product features and experiments.

You will serve as a practical link between business and technical teams. We're looking for someone who learns quickly, investigates problems independently, exercises good judgment, and follows issues through to resolution.

AI-assisted development is a regular part of how our team works. You should be effective at using these tools and reviewing the code they produce, with the technical understanding to identify mistakes, challenge assumptions, and guide work toward reliable results.

### **Responsibilities**

* Support projects led by other BizOps analysts, helping clarify requirements, review technical approaches, and resolve implementation problems.
* Debug issues in existing workflow code, integrations, and data processes. Investigate root causes and implement or coordinate fixes.
* Review BizOps pull requests, including substantial AI-generated changes, for correctness, security, maintainability, and alignment with business requirements. Provide actionable feedback and verify that concerns are addressed.
* Write and maintain Python code, SQL workflows, integrations, and automations supporting the team's work.
* Investigate product bugs, distinguish expected behavior from defects, and gather evidence through code, logs, data, and reproducible examples.
* Write clear tickets for Engineering and Operations that explain the problem, business impact, supporting evidence, and expected outcome. Follow up on dependencies and verify resolutions.
* Manage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services supporting BizOps workflows, including service accounts, permissions, secrets, configuration, and deployments.
* Support Salesforce workflows and integrations, including programming against its application programming interfaces (APIs).
* Analyze product features, experiments, and operational and advertising data. Apply appropriate statistical methods, interpret results accurately, and explain limitations.
* Investigate discrepancies across internal systems and partner platforms.
* Prioritize competing requests and communicate findings, decisions, blockers, and next steps through concise Slack messages, tickets, and documentation.

### **Qualifications**

* At least two years of relevant professional experience in business operations, technical operations, analytics, software development, or a related field.
* Demonstrated technical ability through a bachelor's degree in a field such as engineering, statistics, mathematics, computer science, or physics, or through substantial technical work, research, or projects.
* Strong problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar systems, connect information across sources, and work through ambiguous problems.
* A strong work ethic and sense of ownership: you take initiative, persist through difficult problems, and follow work through to completion.
* Good judgment about data quality, system changes, permissions, and operational risk. You recognize which problems you can resolve independently and when additional expertise or review is needed.
* Effective use of AI coding and workflow tools to develop, review, and maintain substantial volumes of code. You can evaluate generated work, identify mistakes, and steer it toward the intended outcome.
* Practical experience with Python, SQL, Git, pull-request workflows, and APIs, including investigating and debugging existing code.
* Hands-on experience managing GCP services and workflows, including permissions, credentials, configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Experience applying statistical analysis and data science techniques, including selecting appropriate methods, interpreting results accurately, and explaining limitations.
* Experience in advertising technology, with a working understanding of areas such as campaign delivery, attribution, measurement, mediation, monetization, or the iOS and Android ecosystems.
* Clear, concise written communication. You can explain technical issues in business terms, document reproducible problems, and write requirements and tickets that others can act on.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting internal tools, reviewing other people's code, or coordinating technical work across business, Engineering, and Operations teams.
* Experience with Salesforce administration, reporting, permission models, or integrations.
* Experience maintaining production automations, data pipelines, or shared internal applications.
* Familiarity with least-privilege access and sensitive data handling.

### **What Success Looks Like**

BizOps analysts can rely on you to investigate technical problems, review their work thoughtfully, and help their projects move forward. Engineering and Operations receive clear, actionable req

jobs.company: Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco
jobs.title: Program Leader
jobs.description:
Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco — Columbia Park Clubhouse  
San Francisco, CA | Monday–Friday, 25 hours/week during the school year and 40 hours/week during summer | Part-time (school year), Full-time (summer)| $24–$25/hr | Benefits Eligible

##### **Why This Role Matters**

Since 1891, Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco (BGCSF) has provided high-quality, community-based youth development services to youth in San Francisco. Our mission is to inspire and enable all young people, especially those from disadvantaged circumstances, to realize their full potential as productive, responsible, and caring citizens. We impact the lives of Club members, primarily ages 6 to 18, by focusing on academic success, healthy lifestyles, good character and community engagement, and job readiness with earning potential. We are nationally recognized for the high-quality of our programs and comprehensive approach to serving youth. Whether you’re joining our administrative team, a Clubhouse team, a School-Based Club team, or our Camp Mendocino team, you’ll be surrounded by enthusiastic, talented, and passionate colleagues who wake up every day ready to inspire young people to reach their full potential.

##### **What You’ll Do**

Program Leaders are assigned to a Clubhouse department based on their knowledge and expertise, where they design and lead tailored programs, coordinate and supervise field trips, and independently oversee day-to-day department operations. You’ll play a direct role in shaping the lives of youth in our community, and the position is a stepping stone into Clubhouse leadership.

* Keep members safe — Provide a safe, nurturing environment for every youth in your program.
* Facilitate engaging programs — Create and lead after-school programs and activities for a group of approximately ten members.
* Plan purposeful lessons — Develop age-appropriate lesson plans and activities that promote personal growth, educational achievement, and character development.
* Mentor youth — Serve as a positive role model and mentor, building members’ self-esteem and personal development.
* Cultivate Clubhouse culture — Set standards and expectations grounded in mutual respect between staff and the community we serve.
* Lead field trips — Coordinate and supervise department field trips from planning through return.
* Collaborate with the team — Work alongside junior-level colleagues to meet program goals and share best practices.

##### **What You Bring**

###### **Required**

* Minimum two years of youth development experience working with youth ages 6 to 18 in a youth development setting
* Ability to build strong relationships with youth and create engaging curriculum
* Strong positive discipline skills, with the ability to manage youth behavior and maintain high expectations
* Proven communication, organizational, and self-starter skills
* Strong ability to create and follow systems and procedures in a fast-paced environment with continual distractions

###### **Preferred**

* Education or coursework in Early Childhood Development, Education, or a related field
* Current Red Cross First Aid/CPR certification (or willing to obtain within 90 days of employment)
* Proven leadership or mentorship experience
* Bilingual (Spanish Speaking) candidates are highly encouraged to apply

##### **Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to lift 25 lbs.
* Must be able to stand for at least 2 hours consecutively.
* Must be able to sit at a computer workstation for long periods of time.

##### **Why BGCSF**

* Comprehensive health benefits, including employer contributions
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Education assistance
* Pre-tax Transportation Savings Account
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Generous Paid Time Off program
* Paid Holidays
* Life & Disability Insurance
* Professional development opportunities
* Free all-location West Coast Bay Club membership (for FT & PT after 90 days)
* 401(k) Retirement Plan: Pre-tax savings program with a discretionary employer contribution for eligible employees after completing one year of service.

##### **Compensation**

The wage range for this position is $24–$25 per hour. Final compensation is determined based on a range of factors, including skill set, experience, training, certifications, and organizational needs. Candidates may be hired at the entry, mid, or senior level of the range, depending on qualifications and position requirements.

##### **Pre-Employment Requirements**

As part of the hiring process, BGCSF requires candidates to complete LiveScan fingerprinting, a background check, and a tuberculosis (TB) evaluation or test.

##### **Disclaimer**

This job description outlines the general nature and level of work expected in this role. It is not intended as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. BGCSF reserves the right to reassign or relocate employees as needed.

jobs.title: Product Strategy and Operations Lead, Google Play Central Operations
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in management consulting, product management and strategy, or analytics in a technology company.
* Experience working with and analyzing data, and managing multiple projects.
* Experience creating and delivering executive communications.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience leading goal-setting and planning processes (e.g., OKRs, annual planning) across multiple teams or organizations.
* Experience managing cross-organizational partnerships or joint planning processes with multiple stakeholders.
* Experience in a technology company, ideally working with Product and Engineering teams.
* Ability to build effective relationships, influence without authority, and collaborate at all organizational levels.
* Strong strategic, and problem-solving skills, with good business judgment and comfort navigating ambiguity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex topics into concise narratives for senior audiences.

**About the job**
-----------------

Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.  
  
Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.

As the Product Strategy and Operations Lead for Play Central Operations, you will support the operating rhythm that keeps Play leadership aligned, informed, and accountable. You will run the processes that connect strategy to execution across Play, including executive communications, OKR planning and tracking, and Joint Business Planning (JBP) with partner Product Areas (PAs) across Google. You will partner directly with Play leadership, their chiefs of staff, and cross-functional leads to shape priorities, surface risks, and make sure the organization focuses on the most impactful work.  
  
You will sit at the center of Google Play, with visibility into the strategy and execution of the whole organization and regular exposure to Play and Google senior leadership. The role combines strategic thinking with operational ownership, and offers broad influence across many teams and Product Areas.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $150000 - $217000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own and produce executive-ready communications for Play leadership, including leadership newsletters, reviews, business updates, all-hands content, and briefing materials. Turn complex, cross-functional inputs into clear narratives, tailored to each audience.
* Collaborate with the TPM lead to run the annual and quarterly goal setting, track progress and scoring, and flag risks and trade-offs to leadership.
* Co-drive processes with Android. Align on shared goals, dependencies, and resourcing; keep accountability through regular checkpoints; and escalate issues to resolution.
* Design, run, and keep improving the Play leadership operating cadence (e.g., staff meetings, business reviews, decision forums), so that decisions are made and recorded, and action items are followed through to completion.
* Synthesize data and cross-functional inputs into insights and recommendations. Find inefficiencies in central processes and lead improvements that make operations scale better, including adopting AI tools where needed.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: TPO Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Description**

  
**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

We are looking for a TPO Business Analyst to join our TPO Business Strategy team to serve as the analytical engine connecting product development, operations, and enterprise partner feedback. This role will own product and process gap analysis — identifying where our TPO platform falls short against enterprise partner needs, investor requirements, and operational best practices — and translate those findings into actionable requirements for engineering and process improvements for operations. The ideal candidate will have experience in solar finance, business analysis, or operations and will work across Product, Engineering, Operations, Capital Markets, and Risk teams.

This position will be based out of San Francisco, CA or Santa Clara, CA with an in-office schedule set at the direct manager’s discretion in accordance with the company policies and procedures.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Conduct end-to-end product and process gap analyses by mapping the TPO customer journey (sale creation through asset onboarding), identifying structural gaps, and categorizing them by severity and business impact — similar in scope to internal initiatives like Project Clarity.

* Translate voice-of-customer feedback from enterprise installer partners and investor/capital markets stakeholders into structured product requirements and operational process change proposals for Engineering and Operations teams.

* Own change order and milestone enforcement analysis — evaluate current process controls (e.g., CO enforcement at NTP, M2 as-built verification, Year 1 kWh reconciliation), identify attack vectors and failure modes, and design minimum viable fixes that require no or minimal engineering development.

* Build detailed gap analysis deliverables (Word docs, Excel models, process flow diagrams) that clearly articulate current state vs. target state, root cause, and prioritized remediation paths with implementation timelines.

* Partner with the Operations team to redesign operational process flows when gaps are identified — drafting new SOPs, updating milestone checklists, and coordinating rollout across QSS and internal ops stakeholders.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Operations Manager to serve as the operational and managerial backbone of our growing online business. This role turns vision into action through systems, team leadership, project oversight, and operational strategy. A key part of this role is managing a team of 13. This includes a sales team, health coaches, and other team members. Most of the systems and processes are in place, so the biggest focus is the team.

The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, a clear communicator, and confident in managing projects, people, and processes. This is a leadership role designed for someone who thrives on structure, organization, and driving execution.

**About Us**

Elevate Health Naturally is a root-cause health coaching company in the category of **Foundational Medicine**, a systems-based approach that addresses cellular dysfunction in the correct sequence before any detox, hormone, or gut protocol can succeed. We serve women (and men as standalone clients) who know something is wrong, have tried supplements and perhaps seen a functional medicine doctor, got some results, but haven't found anything that lasts, and are ready for a better solution that actually solves the root cause.

Our mission is to empower women to understand their bodies, trust the process of healing, and build lasting health, not just for themselves, but in a ripple effect that heals their husbands, their children, and the generations that follow. We currently have a team of 13, and we are in a growth phase, expanding programs, improving operations, and building long-term sustainability.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Coordination (main focus of the role)**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for the team

* Manage terminations, performance reviews/improvement plans, etc.
* Host all recurring team meetings and one-to-one check-ins

**Operations & Process Management**

* Spot bottlenecks and fix them before they slow the team down
* Create, update, and maintain SOPs for every core process as the business grows
* Manage the project management system and keep workflows current
* Own the tech stack: keep tools and automations working, and recommend upgrades when something no longer fits.

**Project Management**

* Turn strategic initiatives into clear, actionable project plans
* Break down projects into tasks, milestones, and timelines
* Manage projects including launches, funnels, content workflows, and program improvements
* Coordinate team tasks and ensure deadlines are met

**Metrics & Reporting**

* Track and analyze overall business key performance indicators (KPIs)
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports for the CEO
* Review metrics from marketing, sales, retention, and operations to identify trends
* Support data-driven decisions with clear insights and recommendations
* Monitor budgets, timelines, and resource allocation

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Required Qualifications**

* 3-5 years of experience in Operations, Project Management, or similar role
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Ability to lead team members and maintain accountability
* Detail-oriented with strong follow-through

jobs.title: Health Coach - Nutrition and Weight lifting for women in midlife
jobs.description:
**About the Opportunity**

We are seeking a passionate and energetic Health Coach specializing in nutrition and weight lifting for women in midlife. In this role, you will empower women to embrace their health journey by instructing them on proper nutrition, lifestyle changes and exercise (specifically weight lifting) to meet their health and weight loss goals.

Many of our patients are navigating perimenopause or menopause and feel frustrated that the diet and exercise strategies that worked in the past are no longer producing the same results. We are looking for someone who can turn education into practical, personalized habits—and provide the encouragement and accountability patients need to follow through.

Dr Camille is a functional medicine doctor who helps them with hormone, thyroid and nutrient optimization, and highly recommends diet changes and weight lifting, but needs a health coach to provide accountability and support.

This role will initially focus on supporting existing patients, with the opportunity to help develop and deliver an expanded online coaching program.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement individualized care plans focused on nutrition, weight management, and strength training tailored specifically for women in midlife
* Provide motivational interviewing and behavioral health strategies to foster positive change and boost client confidence
* Offer emotional support and active listening to help clients overcome challenges and stay motivated throughout their wellness journey
* Conduct virtual coaching sessions via video conferencing software, ensuring clear communication and engagement
* Educate clients on healthy eating habits, weight loss techniques, and safe weight lifting practices aligned with their fitness levels and health conditions
* Maintain detailed records of client progress, including lifestyle counseling notes, activity logs, and goal tracking

**Skills**

* Excellent client rapport building and communication skills to foster trust and motivation
* Proficiency in health & wellness coaching, personal training, nutrition, and knowledge about the specific needs of women in midlife, ages 40-60 years old.
* Knowledge of nutrition principles, weight loss strategies, and safe strength training methods for midlife women
* Experience with video conferencing software for remote coaching sessions
* Coach women individually on nutrition, exercise, lifestyle, and sustainable behavior change.
* Help patients establish realistic habits around protein intake, balanced meals, strength training, daily movement, sleep, and recovery.
* Provide practical fitness guidance tailored to each patient’s experience, goals, available equipment, and physical limitations.
* Help patients work through barriers such as busy schedules, inconsistent routines, low motivation, and conflicting health information.
* Track progress beyond the scale, including strength, consistency, energy, and body composition when appropriate.
* Collaborate with the physician to reinforce each patient’s care plan and communicate concerns or challenges.
* Potentially contribute to educational resources, group coaching, and the development of a comprehensive virtual program for women in midlife.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* Experience coaching women in their 40s, 50s, and beyond.
* A strong foundation in both nutrition coaching and fitness, particularly progressive resistance training and weight lifting
* Understanding of how perimenopause and menopause can affect body composition, muscle mass, sleep, recovery, and weight management.
* Familiarity with functional medicine and an interest in collaborating within a physician-led practice.
* A practical, evidence-informed approach that emphasizes adequate nutrition, muscle preservation, and sustainable habits.
* Warm, clear communication and the ability to provide accountability without judgment.
* Comfort conducting virtual sessions and using online scheduling, documentation, and communication tools.
* Strong organization, reliability, and follow-through.

Join us in creating a vibrant community where women feel empowered to take charge of their health! This role is perfect for motivated professionals passionate about inspiring positive change through personalized coaching that combines nutrition expertise with strength training. We value energetic individuals committed to making a difference—apply today to become part of our wellness-focused team!

Pay: From $50.00 per hour

Expected hours: 1.0 – 10.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: IT Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

The IT Operations Manager runs day-to-day IT operations, endpoint security, and support across Cordance HQ and its business units. The role is the hands-on owner of our IT tooling, our managed service providers, and the transition of business units onto a common HQ-managed platform.

Because Cordance operates across multiple business units, this role balances central standards with each unit's individual systems, audits, and deadlines. The IT Operations Manager also supplies the evidence and controls that business units need for SOC 2 and other security certifications.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **IT Operations and Support**

* Own IT service management across HQ and business units, including ticket quality, escalations, and SLAs with the helpdesk provider (currently 1Path).
* Run joiner, mover, and leaver processes, including provisioning and removing access across Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS, and business applications, working with HR on identity data from Rippling.
* Maintain and keep current the IT Operations Runbook, covering systems, procedures, contacts, and escalation paths.

### **Endpoint and Security Tooling**

* Administer the RMM and endpoint stack, including NinjaOne for device management and SentinelOne for EDR, and keep device inventories reconciled between them.
* Administer email and web security, including Abnormal Security and Cisco Umbrella, across multi-org and EU tenants.
* Enforce agent installation and device compliance on all company-managed devices and follow up with non-compliant users.
* Triage security alerts and integration health issues and route them to the appropriate team or provider.

### **Infrastructure and Cloud**

* Support the AWS landing zone and cloud access for business units and keep its documentation current.
* Manage identity, access, and tenant configuration across Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace environments.

### **Business Unit Integration and Vendor Management**

* Deliver IT and security integration workstreams that move business units from legacy MSPs onto HQ-managed tooling and in-house support.
* Hold MSPs and vendors accountable to deadlines for onboarding, offboarding, and tool removal, and report status and risk to leadership.
* Review and approve MSP invoices and manage hardware procurement with suppliers.

### **Compliance Support**

* Provide device, access, and configuration evidence for SOC 2 and other security certifications.
* Close gaps identified during audits and implement a continuous compliance framework to ensure infrastructure is audit-ready and compliant.

**Competencies**
----------------

* Strong IT operations and infrastructure management capabilities.
* Hands-on expertise managing identity, access, endpoints, and cloud environments.
* Ability to manage outsourced helpdesk providers, MSPs, and technology vendors against defined SLAs and deadlines.
* Ability to balance centralized IT standards with the needs of multiple business units and technology environments.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain accurate operational documentation and compliance evidence.
* Ability to communicate clearly with executives, vendors, and non-technical users.
* Strong ownership and follow-through when managing integrations, escalations, security issues, and audit requirements.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 7+ years of experience in IT operations or infrastructure, including 3+ years leading IT operations or managing MSPs.
* Hands-on administration of Microsoft 365 / Entra ID and Google Workspace, including identity, access, and tenant settings.
* Hands-on experience with an RMM platform, with NinjaOne preferred, and an EDR platform, with SentinelOne preferred.
* Working knowledge of AWS and Azure, including IAM, account structure, and landing zones.
* Proven record of managing outsourced helpdesk or MSP contracts against SLAs and deadlines.
* Experience supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits with technical evidence.
* Experience with M&A integration or running IT across several business units or tenants.
* Clear written communication with executives, vendors, and non-technical users.
* Bachelor's degree in IT, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with Abnormal Security, Cisco Umbrella, or similar email and DNS security tools.
* Scripting experience for automation using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert or AWS Certified SysOps Administrator certification.
* Security certification such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or CISM.
* Familiarity with GDPR and managing EU data residency across tenants.
* Experience working with a global team, including overlap with India (IST) hours.

**Success Measurements**
------------------------

* Consistent IT service delivery across Cordance HQ and its business units, including effective management of tickets, escalations

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Project Manager**

Design In DC is a digital agency built for the future. Over the past years, we have brought together an energetic and diverse team of experts who work in harmony to optimize every touch point of the user’s website journey. It is clear that the future is digital which is why we are forward-thinking builders; design architects, and engineers that construct digital products and experiences for businesses and brands.

When you work with us, you get a global team driven by thinking, rethinking, and consumer insights as a means to change and disrupt. We bring together the best creative minds who use traditional methodologies to defy tradition. That is why we are a full-service agency with a unique and diverse arsenal of skills, from web design and development, to marketing and app development, to videography and animation. It is our mission to provide a solution to any question that you may ask. So let’s build something for the future together.

Currently, we are actively searching for an organized and detail-oriented Project Manager to join our team in a fully remote position. The ideal candidate is a clear communicator who keeps projects on track, works closely with clients and creative teams, and delivers digital projects on time, within scope and to a high standard.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Project Planning:** Define project scope, timelines, milestones and deliverables for web, design, marketing and other digital projects.
* **Budget Management:** Estimate project costs, track hours and spending against the budget, and flag overruns or scope changes before they affect profitability.
* **Team Coordination:** Assign and coordinate work across designers, developers and marketing specialists, making sure everyone knows their priorities and deadlines.
* **Client Communication:** Act as the main point of contact for clients. Gather requirements, share regular status updates, and make sure client feedback is understood and acted on.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Human Evaluations (Recommendations)
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Great recommendations are how members find something worth their time. We are looking for an experienced Human Evaluations Program Manager to help us measure and improve the quality of recommendations across the Netflix homepage and discovery experience. You will work alongside Product Management and ML teams to build the human evaluation programs that tell us whether recommendations are working for members, and where they are not.

**About the Role**

Netflix is building toward more relevant, more varied, and more trustworthy recommendations, and thoughtful, high-quality evaluation is essential to making sure we are moving in the right direction. Join a team creating the frameworks, tools, and workflows that ensure human judgment is applied with consistency, clarity, and care, whether we are evaluating relevance, repetition, diversity, or whether a recommendation simply makes sense to the member.

You will not only shape how human evaluations of our recommendations are designed, but also own the day-to-day execution. From scoping and planning to vendor management, rater onboarding, and calibration, you will be accountable for driving delivery from start to finish. Just as critically, you will act as a thought partner to Product Management, helping translate recommendation strategy into evaluation designs and building a shared language around recommendation quality across teams.

**The Opportunity**

In this role, you will partner across product, research, data science, UX, and engineering to develop rubrics, frameworks, and workflows that enable rigorous, scalable human evaluation of recommendations. Beyond shaping the "what" and "how," you will also lead the "when" and "done." You will keep evaluation projects on track, ensuring consistent execution, timely delivery, efficient use of vendor capacity, and high rater alignment. If you are excited to bring structure to ambiguity and influence what members see when they open Netflix, while being accountable for tangible delivery, this is your chance to create meaningful impact from day one.

**The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of structure and flexibility. You know how to create evaluation frameworks that are rigorous and scalable, and you are also a driver who gets them out the door. You are skilled at translating product strategy into evaluation workflows, defining milestones, managing vendors, and delivering consistent results in a dynamic environment. You can steer teams across functions, keep timelines on track, and ensure rater quality without micromanaging. You are curious about how personalization works and can build credibility with PMs, data scientists, and ML engineers. You have working fluency in film and TV content and can quickly scan a set of titles to tell whether they belong together. You thrive in spaces where there is no roadmap, and you take pride in making things real, not just possible.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end execution of human evaluation and data operations initiatives, from intake and scoping to delivery
* Partner with Product Management to translate recommendation strategy and roadmap priorities into evaluation designs, success metrics, and timelines
* Manage human annotation vendors, including capacity planning, SLAs, quality performance, and escalations
* Drive operational efficiency across evaluation programs, including cost per task, throughput, turnaround time, and speed to IRR
* Develop clear, scalable guidelines and scoring rubrics to ensure consistent rater judgment, including for subjective, taste-based questions
* Oversee rater onboarding, calibration, and QA workflows
* Pilot and refine evaluation tasks to improve clarity, inter-rater reliability, and feedback quality
* Anticipate and resolve bottlenecks and blockers
Act as the connective tissue across product, ML, data science, and vendor partners to ensure alignment and effective execution of evaluations at scale  

**Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience working in human evaluations, data collection, labeling, or annotation operations in ML environments
* Track record of implementing process improvements or quality control systems for data collection needs
* Prior experience managing human annotation vendors, raters, or data labeling teams, including vendor performance and cost management
* Experience improving operational efficiency of annotation programs (throughput, turnaround, cost)
* Strong understanding of evaluation design, including guidelines, rubrics, and scoring protocols
* Working fluency in film and TV content, including genres, formats, and talent
* Proven ability in end-to-end management of complex, cross-functional programs, demonstrating strong Program Management skills and clear accountability for successful delivery
* Experience with human labeling platforms
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to synthesize feedback into clear recommendations and process improvements
* Familiarity with how rater subjectivity and bias affect taste-based judgments, and how to account for them in evaluation design
Strong organizational skills and executional focus; ability to track details while seeing the bigger picture  

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with personalization, recommender systems, search, or ranking evaluation
* Familiarity with how offline human evaluation complements online experimentation (A/B tests) and engagement metrics
* Experience evaluating at the list or page level, not only the individual item level
* Experience partnering with Product Managers and Data Scientists on metric

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

**ROLE PURPOSE**
  
The TUNTAS Program Manager is the senior operational lead for the TUNTAS program. The role sets strategic direction, ensures technical quality, and makes sure program investments draw on Indonesia’s wider education system and donor landscape.
  
The role leads the design and delivery of an integrated package of technical assistance to district and provincial governments. The program aims to reduce school dropout and improve educational outcomes for vulnerable children and young people. It does this by strengthening access to inclusive, quality, and relevant learning through youth empowerment, school and community engagement, and sustainable education systems. It covers four districts in the two provinces with the highest concentration of dropout risk: Bogor and Depok (West Java), and Sidoarjo and Malang (East Java).
  
The role keeps the TUNTAS program design consistent and connected with other Save the Children initiatives in Indonesia, and aligned with the DBS Foundation, to maximize impact and support lasting system change. The position requires deep expertise in the Indonesian education system, both formal and non-formal. It also requires proven experience delivering large-scale capacity building at the local level and a strong grounding in adult learning and systems-strengthening approaches.
  
**KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY**
  
**Technical Leadership and Program Quality**

* Lead the overall implementation of the TUNTAS program across target locations, in line with the approved program design, donor commitments, national education priorities, and Save the Children’s policies and quality standards.

* Integrate life skills, dropout prevention, education continuity, and re-engagement pathways into one coherent program approach.
* Systematically integrate Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI), climate change, child protection, and child participation into program design and implementation.

* Ensure adherence to good programming guidelines, including international good practice.
* Raise any implementation issues with the line manager, with recommendations for resolution.
* Work with the Program Impact & Policy Department to maintain program quality framework standards and identify opportunities for scaling up work in project areas.

#### **Description**

Rankings.io is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and client-focused Video Account Manager to join our growing Video Department.

In this role, you'll serve as a key point of contact for clients, ensuring a seamless experience from onboarding through content production, approvals, publishing, and ongoing account management. You'll work closely with our internal video production, creative, and advertising teams to keep projects moving, deadlines on track, and clients informed every step of the way.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates with confidence, and doesn't wait to be told what needs to happen next. You should be comfortable managing multiple client accounts, juggling competing priorities, and following through until the job is done.

#### **Responsibilities**

**Client Onboarding & Account Setup**

* Own the client onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and professional experience from day one.
* Coordinate welcome calls, account connection meetings, and onboarding follow-ups.
* Communicate onboarding requirements, next steps, and outstanding action items to clients.
* Set up and maintain client accounts, project boards, and communication channels in ClickUp and Slack.

* Track outstanding approvals and follow up to keep advertising campaigns on schedule.

* Manage day-to-day client communications through Slack, email, and scheduled meetings.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About HappyRobot  
  
HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

The Role  
  
As a Customer Success Manager, you will own the post-sale relationship with a portfolio of large, enterprise customers. You will make sure each customer sees real, measurable value from their AI workforce, and then help them expand it to new workflows, teams, and regions. You will work side by side with our forward-deployed engineers, deployment strategists, and account executives, and you will be the voice of the customer inside HappyRobot.  
This is a strategic role, not a support role. Our customers are adopting a new kind of technology, and you will guide them from first deployment to a fully scaled AI operation. We are especially interested in candidates with a logistics background who can earn the trust of large, complex organizations and speak the language of their operations teams.  
  
What You Will Do

* Own a portfolio of large enterprise accounts and act as the primary day-to-day and executive-level contact.
* Drive adoption and time-to-value by defining success metrics with each customer, such as resolution time, load coverage, calls automated, and cost savings.
* Run regular business reviews that translate performance data into clear business outcomes and next steps.
* Identify and lead expansion opportunities into new use cases, business units, and geographies, partnering closely with Sales.
* Partner with forward-deployed engineers and deployment strategists to scope, launch, and iterate on new workflows.
* Monitor account health, anticipate risk, and lead renewals with a clear view of value delivered.
* Capture customer feedback and turn it into actionable input for Product and Engineering.
* Build repeatable playbooks, onboarding materials, and best practices as the Customer Success function scales.

What You Bring

* 4 to 7 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS or technology company, with experience managing enterprise accounts.
* **Preferred:** Hands-on logistics, freight, or supply chain experience (for example at a freight broker, 3PL, carrier, shipper, or logistics technology company), ideally managing large, multi-stakeholder accounts.
* A track record of driving adoption, retention, and expansion, with comfort owning renewal and growth targets.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate with both operators on the floor and C-level stakeholders.
* Comfort with data. You can read usage and performance metrics, build a clear narrative around them, and recommend next steps.
* Technical curiosity. You do not need to code, but you should be comfortable discussing integrations, APIs, workflows, and AI concepts with customers and engineers.
* A bias for ownership and speed, with the ability to thrive in ambiguity at a fast-growing startup.

Nice to Have

* Experience with AI, automation, or voice products.
* Familiarity with TMS, WMS, or CRM systems.
* Spanish, Portuguese, or another language, given our LatAm and international customer base.
* Prior experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup.

Why Join Us

* Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
* Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital, and Eurazeo.
* Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
* Comprehensive benefits including healthcare, dental, and vision coverage.
* Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles  
  
**Extreme Ownership**  
We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting. If something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it is not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We do not wait for someone else to solve it. We lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

**Craftsmanship**  
Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping outcomes by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build, even when nobody is watching.

**We are “majos”**  
Be friendly and have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine and honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

**Urgency with Focus**  
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We are running a high-speed marathon, not a sprint with no strategy.

**Talent Density and Meritocracy**  
Hire only people who can raise the average; exceptional performance is the passing grade. Ability trumps seniority. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure.

**First-Principles Thinking**  
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, and rebuild the solution from scratch. We do not copy-paste solutions.

Compensation Range: $120K - $180K

As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.

**Position Summary:**

Onit is seeking a strategic and customer-focused Customer Success Manager, ideally, with a background in State, Local, and Education legal operations to support our LegalFiles portfolio of customers. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor —partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure customer satisfaction, drive product adoption, and maximize value from Onit’s legal tech solutions. Your legal operations expertise will position you to effectively understand customer pain points, align platform capabilities to strategic goals, and guide clients through technical conversations, workflow optimizations, and platform best practices.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Build strong relationships with LegalFiles customers to understand their legal operations goals and drive value realization from Onit solutions.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic accounts, ensuring a seamless and proactive customer experience.
* Translate legal ops pain points (e.g., billing challenges, matter management gaps, workflow inefficiencies) into actionable technical solutions.
* Guide customers through onboarding, configuration recommendations, and best practices tailored to their maturity and objectives.
* Triage and manage support escalations, working closely with Product, Engineering, and Support to drive resolution and root cause analysis.
* Advocate internally for customer needs and product enhancements by identifying recurring themes and improvement opportunities.
* Conduct regular business reviews, usage assessments, and roadmap discussions to ensure alignment with customer goals.
* Document customer-specific workflows, integrations, and technical considerations to support continuity across internal teams.
* Maintain consistent communication and engagement cadence with accounts, including QBRs, advisory sessions, and performance reviews.

### **Required Skills:**

* 5+ years of experience in a Customer Success or a customer-facing role (e.g., legal operations, vendor management, legal analyst, or customer success).
* Proven success supporting enterprise clients in a SaaS environment, preferably in B2B legal tech or enterprise software.
* Familiarity with legal ops processes including eBilling platforms, matter management, legal billing, and outside counsel guidelines is preferred.
* Awareness of audit practices and industry standards such as LEDES and UTBMS.
* Strong ability to engage with both technical stakeholders and non-technical legal ops users, advocating effectively for both.
* Experience mapping legal workflows and identifying opportunities for automation, efficiency, and process improvement.
* Strong organizational and communication skills, capable of managing multiple complex engagements simultaneously.
* Comfort navigating APIs, cloud platforms, and custom integrations.
* Bonus: Familiarity with enterprise risk or GRC software platforms.

At Onit, we’re committed to offering fair and competitive compensation. In addition to base pay, associates are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. The final base salary you receive will reflect factors such as your skills, education, experience, and work location.

**Benefits & Perks That Support You:**

Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:

**Health Coverage Choices:** Three medical plan options, plus dental and vision, so you can choose what fits best. Employees on our HDHP plan also receive employer contribution to the HSA.

**Retirement Savings:** 401(k) with a 100% match on the first 3% and 50% on the next 2% of employee contributions.

**Time Away:** Flexible paid time off, 7 sick days, and 9 paid company holidays annually.

**Family Support:** Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.

**Income Protection:** 100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.

**Additional Coverage Options:** Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident, and even pet insurance.

**Tax-Advantaged Accounts:** Healthcare FSA, HSA, and dependent care FSA.

**Community Engagement:** One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.

**Our Commitment to Applicants**

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.

This position will remain open for applications for 7 calendar days from the posting date.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager - Healthcare
jobs.description:
###### **About Vasion**

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

###### **About the role**

Vasion is looking for a Technical Account Manager who becomes the technical point of contact for our healthcare customers after the sale, working with hospital and health-system IT teams, from day-to-day administrators to IT directors, to keep the platform healthy, adopted, and growing long after go-live. We modernize how organizations handle documents, print, and content workflows, replacing fragmented legacy tools with a single, secure platform. In healthcare, that means print and document workflows that clinicians never have to think about, and IT teams that are never surprised.

###### **At a Glance**

* **Segment:** Healthcare accounts: hospitals, health systems, and multi-site provider networks
* **Vertical focus:** Healthcare
* **Engagement model:** Post-sales technical ownership across adoption, retention, and expansion
* **Work model:** Remote; ability to travel up to 20% [confirm]
* **Success metrics:** Gross retention on assigned accounts, risk identified before the customer raises it, adoption milestones met, expansion ARR influenced

###### **What Success Looks Like**

You find problems before our customers do. Every account in your book has a current technical plan that the customer's own technical owner has agreed to, and that plan already accounts for the EHR upgrade, the new clinic opening, and the audit that are coming. Escalations end with a root cause and a fix that holds. Renewals are a confirmation, not a negotiation, because the technical trust was built a year earlier.

###### **What you'll do**

**Ownership of the technical relationship across healthcare accounts: preventing risk, driving adoption, and growing customers over time.**

* **Proactive technical advisory:** Anticipate deployment, adoption, and stability risk across your accounts before the customer raises it. Turn release changes, configuration drift, and usage patterns into recommendations that name the risk, the likely impact, and the choice available to the customer, and be clear about which conclusions are firm and which need more evidence.
* **Technical account planning:** Own a twelve-month technical plan for each account, grounded in the health system's real growth, projects, and constraints, and agreed with the customer's technical owner. Keep a forward calendar of EHR upgrades and cutovers, new site openings, acquisitions, audits, and clinical change freezes, so Vasion hears about them before they arrive as escalations.
* **Clinical workflow adoption:** Help customers get the full value of what they already own, including secure pull and badge-based printing, serverless print management, and EHR-connected print and document workflows across shared clinical workstations and virtual desktops. Convert unused capability into adoption commitments.
* **Escalation leadership:** Lead the technical response when one of your accounts escalates, especially when printing or document delivery touches patient-facing operations. Coordinate Support and Engineering, give the customer one voice, and confirm the fix has held before closing it out.
* **Service delivery and renewal support:** Manage entitlement consumption across your book, coordinate Professional Services, Support, and partners, and give Customer Success the technical input needed to protect renewals, quarters ahead.
* **Expansion:** Identify new use cases inside the account, such as document workflow and capture needs, and build the technical case with Customer Success and Sales.
* **Field feedback and enablement:** Share healthcare field insight with Product and Engineering, and contribute runbooks, health-check templates, and reference architectures to the shared library.

###### **What You Bring**

**Strong technical grounding, healthcare IT fluency, and a structured approach to keeping accounts healthy and growing:**

* **Post-sales technical advisory:** Health reviews, adoption planning, review delivery, escalation coordination, and clear communication from IT administrator to Director level.
* **Architecture and systems thinking:** Ability to read and critique a customer's deployment architecture, including multi-site and virtualized environments.
* **Networking and identity:** Troubleshooting DNS, proxies, and firewalls; strong grasp of LDAP and SSO (Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Ping), plus badge and tap-to-authenticate workflows such as Imprivata.
* **Security and compliance:** Working knowledge of HIPAA and HITECH requirements as they apply to print and output management; awareness of SOC 2 and ISO.
* **Domain expertise:** Print, Workflow, and Output Automation in cloud and hybrid environments; familiarity with EHR platforms (Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner) and the print and document patterns around them.
* **Technical toolbox:** Diagramming; bash and/or PowerShell; SQL basics; RESTful APIs; Jira; AI-assisted workflows.

###### **Qualifications**

**Hands-on post-sales experience and the technical depth to earn trust with customer administrators:**

* 3-5+ years in technical account management, post-sales engineering, or senior technical support for SaaS or enterprise software
* Track record owning enterprise accounts through renewal cycles and escalations
* Comfortable engaging technical owners and decision makers, with strong writing and presentation skills
*

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Why Join Evotix?**

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue **Excellence**, show **Leadership**, deliver **Impact**, earn **Trust**, and **Empower** those around them.

**Overview**

*The expected total earnings for this role is $100,000-150,000. This is made up of both a base salary and a commission package.*

Our customers already trust us. Your job is to keep that trust strong, and make it grow.

We truly value our customers. Happy, engaged customers renew. They renew for longer. And they buy more. That’s the chain this role runs on. You’ll own a large book of enterprise accounts, and your first job is making sure each customer is getting real value and feels heard. When they do, healthy, longer-term contracts and expansion follow.

You’ll work with **EHS Directors**, executives and budget holders, often in the same account at once. You’ll run many accounts, renewals, deals and stakeholders in parallel, and keep every one of them moving.

This is a fast, busy role. Priorities shift daily, deadlines are real, and the details matter. We need someone who thrives in that, stays organized under pressure, and acts with urgency.

**What You'll Do**

**Keep customers engaged and renewing**

* Build real relationships with day-to-day users, EHS Directors and executive sponsors in every account.
* Check in often and early. Know how each customer is doing, spot risk before it becomes a problem, and act fast.
* Own the renewal cycle from start to finish. Start conversations early, and aim for longer-term contracts, not short extensions.
* Work with Customer Success to make sure customers are adopting the product and getting results they can point to.
* Bring in the right people (Product, Implementation, leadership) when an account needs help.
* Your outcome: engaged customers, healthy contracts, and renewals that are on time and on longer terms.

**Grow our biggest accounts**

* Spot where Evotix can solve bigger problems, then sell additional modules and own expansion and upsell deals through to close.
* Study your customer base, then build account and territory plans that show where the next opportunity is.
* Sell consultatively to EHS Directors, C-level leaders and budget holders.
* Drive complex, multi-stakeholder deals to close, and prospect steadily to keep your pipeline full.
* Your outcome: a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline and wider adoption of the Evotix portfolio.
* **Deliver the best of Evotix**
* Work with Customer Success, Sales, Solutions Consulting and customer squads to find and move opportunities forward.
* Line up pricing, collateral and deal strategy with sales leadership, and bring in Implementation at the right moment.
* Partner with Events and Marketing to raise our profile in target accounts.
* Share customer needs, market insight and competitor moves with Product and Marketing.
* Your outcome: a seamless customer experience and a repeatable renewal, upsell and cross-sell playbook.
* **Keep the deal machine tight**
* Keep CRM records, pipeline data, activity and forecasts complete and accurate, including renewal dates and account health.
* Handle tenders, service order forms and purchase-order requirements.
* Negotiate terms with guidance from sales leadership and get agreements signed.
* Represent Evotix at conferences, exhibitions and industry forums. Customer visits and international travel may be required.
* Your outcome: well-run deals, forecasts people can trust, and a smooth handover to Implementation.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* Experience selling SaaS software, with a track record of hitting revenue targets.
* Proven success keeping customers happy and renewing, ideally on multi-year terms.
* Proven success growing existing accounts through expansion, upsell or cross-sell.
* Strong consultative selling skills, including with senior executives and several decision-makers at once.
* Experience building account plans, generating pipeline and moving complex deals forward.
* Disciplined pipeline management and forecasting, with CRM habits you don’t skip.
* Excellent organization and prioritization. You can juggle many accounts and stakeholders without dropping details.
* A sense of urgency. You move fast, follow up fast and finish what you start.
* Clear writing, resilience and flexibility when plans change.
* A hungry, self-starting, collaborative style. You’re honest, you listen well and you build relationships easily.
* **Desirable**
* Experience selling EHS, health and safety, sustainability or related enterprise software.
* Experience helping shape renewal, expansion or team-selling playbooks.
* Time in a PE-backed SaaS company or another fast-scaling business.
