jobs.title: Onboarding & Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

### **About Campus Kaizen**

Campus Kaizen, a business unit of Cordance, delivers Guardian Case Management — a purpose-built software platform for K–12 school districts and higher education institutions. Guardian centralizes sensitive case workflows including Title IX, HR, Bullying, Employee Relations, Behavioral Intervention Teams (BIT), Student Conduct, and more, replacing spreadsheets and disconnected systems with secure, compliant processes. Our platform enables districts and institutions to improve response times, strengthen documentation, and manage cases with greater transparency, consistency, and efficiency.

### **Position Overview**

As an Implementation Specialist, you’ll be the bridge between our customers and our technology teams, ensuring that each customer’s onboarding experience is seamless, structured, and aligned with their business goals. You’ll manage the end-to-end implementation process for new and expanding customers, working closely with sales, product, support, and success teams to ensure successful launches with measurable outcomes.

This is a hands-on role ideal for someone who enjoys translating business needs into action, solving complex onboarding challenges, and helping customers reach value quickly. This role is accountable for delivering high-quality, on-time implementations that set the foundation for long-term customer retention and growth.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own the full onboarding lifecycle — from requirements gathering to post-launch review — ensuring timelines, milestones, and deliverables are met.
* Partner with customers to identify use cases, workflows, and success criteria that guide system configuration and setup.
* Manage data imports, integrations, and configurations to ensure systems align with customer needs.
* Collaborate with internal product, engineering, and support teams to troubleshoot issues and optimize implementation processes.
* Identify recurring onboarding challenges and propose scalable, repeatable solutions to improve efficiency and quality.
* Track and report implementation metrics, customer satisfaction, and launch readiness across projects.
* Be a voice of the customer in internal discussions, influencing roadmap priorities and process improvements.
* Support customers through adoption and process alignment, providing practical guidance to help teams transition to new workflows and fully leverage the system as designed.
* Monitor and manage implementation scope to ensure projects stay aligned with agreed requirements, timelines, and outcomes.
* Proactively identify implementation risks and dependencies, escalating early and developing mitigation plans to protect timelines and outcomes.

### **Competencies**

* **Customer-Centric Execution:** Drives implementations with a focus on customer outcomes and time-to-value. Anticipates needs, resolves blockers early, and builds trusted relationships through consistent communication and follow-through.
* **Project Ownership and Delivery:** Manages multiple customer implementations end-to-end with precision. Balances scope, schedule, and quality while maintaining accountability for milestones and customer satisfaction.
* **Technical and Analytical Agility:** Understands product functionality, integration workflows, and data mapping. Uses data and analytics to troubleshoot issues, optimize configurations, and inform improvement opportunities.
* **AI Literacy:** Understands AI basics and validates AI-generated technical steps or best practices. Use AI for basic troubleshooting assistance, ensuring accuracy before advising customers.
* **Systems and Process Thinking:** Sees implementations as part of a connected ecosystem — linking product, data, and customer workflows. Identifies dependencies and designs scalable solutions that improve repeatability and quality.
* **Collaboration and Influence:** Partners effectively with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to align goals and ensure seamless handoffs. Communicates context and rationale to drive clarity and shared ownership.
* **Communication and Professionalism:** Translates complex technical information into clear, actionable guidance for both customers and internal teams. Maintains proactive, transparent communication throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* **Adaptability and Continuous Improvement:** Embraces change and experimentation in processes, tools, and product evolution. Continuously seeks ways to increase efficiency, shorten time-to-value, and enhance customer experience.
* **Adoption, Change & Scope Discipline:** Supports customers through process shifts while applying sound judgment in managing requirements and change requests. Protects scope while maintaining a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach.

### **Required Qualifications**

* 2–5 years of experience in implementation, onboarding, or customer success roles — preferably in a SaaS or technology environment.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple customer implementations simultaneously.
* Familiarity with integration concept

Once someone becomes a Motley Fool member, the product they use every day is what earns their renewal. Our vision moves us from stock picks to a full investing system and platform experience, this role owns building it.

As a Product Manager for Member Experience, you'll own the daily product surface — dashboard, portfolio tools, personalization, and mobile — built on top of the AI scoring and research engine our Intelligence team maintains.

* With your cross-functional team, own member engagement as your core metric, the product-side driver of renewal.

* Write specs precise enough for engineers and AI agents to build against, and bring a business case to our weekly product review. This is a decision-making forum, not a status update.

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally on a consumer or subscription product with a strong engagement/retention focus
* A committed active investor with real skin in the game — you understand our members because you are one

* AI-native working style — comfortable prototyping fast and working alongside AI agents day to day

***Position is for an Instructional Designer OR Senior Instructional Designer***

**Position Summary**

The Sr. Instructional Designer is responsible for the design, development, and ongoing improvement of learning programs and training content that support organizational and workforce capability needs. The primary focus of this position is the creation of new training programs and the review and modernization of existing learning content.

This position applies instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies to translate business, technical, and operational requirements into structured and effective learning solutions. The Sr. Instructional Designer works closely with subject matter experts and key stakeholders to ensure training content is accurate, relevant, practical, and aligned with the needs of the organization and the energy industry.

The role requires a strong degree of independence and ownership. The Sr. Instructional Designer is expected to manage multiple learning initiatives simultaneously, establish and maintain project plans and priorities, coordinate content development and review activities, and drive work through completion with limited oversight.

**Primary Responsibilities**

· Design and develop new training programs based on identified business, workforce, and performance needs.

· Review, revise, and modernize existing training programs and learning materials to improve accuracy, relevance, consistency, and effectiveness.

· Apply instructional design principles, adult learning theory, and appropriate learning methodologies throughout the development process.

· Develop learning objectives, course structures, instructional content, assessments, facilitator materials, job aids, and other learning resources.

· Translate complex technical, operational, and business information into clear, structured, learner-focused content.

· Partner with subject matter experts to gather, validate, and organize technical and industry-specific information.

· Ensure training content reflects appropriate energy industry terminology, practices, processes, and operating context.

· Determine appropriate learning approaches and delivery methods based on the audience, subject matter, and desired performance outcomes.

· Establish and maintain standards, templates, and processes for training content development and maintenance.

· Manage multiple learning development projects, including project plans, timelines, stakeholder reviews, approvals, and deliverables.

· Maintain organized training documentation, source materials, content inventories, and version control.

· Establish processes for the periodic review and maintenance of existing learning content.

· Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs and use feedback, assessment results, and stakeholder input to identify opportunities for improvement.

· Independently identify issues, establish priorities, and drive learning initiatives from initial need through implementation.

**Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

· Demonstrated knowledge of the energy industry, including an understanding of industry terminology, operations, business processes, and/or technical environments.

· Strong knowledge of instructional design principles, adult learning theory, and learning development methodologies.

· Demonstrated experience designing and developing training programs from initial concept through implementation.

· Experience evaluating, revising, and modernizing existing training content.

· Ability to synthesize complex technical or operational information and translate it into clear and effective learning content.

· Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

· Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership of work with limited direction.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to content quality and accuracy.

· Ability to establish productive working relationships with technical subject matter experts, business leaders, and other stakeholders.

· Ability to facilitate in-person or virtual training, content-development discussions, resolve conflicting input, and move stakeholders toward decisions.

· Proficiency with learning technologies, eLearning development tools, and learning management systems appropriate to the organization.

**Education & Experience**

new_jobs.description:
Eikon Therapeutics is a new biopharmaceutical company employing revolutionary technology at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, computation, and biology to discover novel treatments for life-threatening diseases. Eikon's discovery platform is built on groundbreaking innovations from its founders (Nobel Prize, 2014), culminating in the creation of microscopes which enable real time, molecular-resolution measurements of protein movement in living cells, thereby unlocking otherwise intractable classes of proteins as drug targets.

**Position**  
As the Lab Ops Supervisor, you will oversee day-to-day operations of our chemistry labs, supervise 1 direct report (lab support technician), directly report to the Senior Director, and work closely with research teams to ensure optimal lab performance. You will be responsible for maintaining laboratory equipment, managing chemical inventory and solvent preparation, enforcing safety protocols, and fostering a collaborative work environment.

**About you**  
A highly organized and proactive professional with strong communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills. Able to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and effectively support laboratory operations and scientific teams. Adaptable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic research environment.

**What You'll Do:**

* Supervise and assist laboratory technicians by delegating tasks and regularly monitoring their progress to ensure the completion of assignments and the efficient use of resources.
* Carry out designated routine activities.
* Ensure the upkeep and calibration of laboratory equipment, guaranteeing its constant readiness for operation.
* Manage and track equipment inventory and equipment monitoring.
* Prepare and maintain solvent and reagent stock solutions to support daily lab operations.
* Maintain accurate chemical inventory, including tracking stock levels, expiration dates, proper labeling, and storage.
* Handle and coordinate the disposal of hazardous chemical waste in compliance with EPA, OSHA, and other applicable regulations.
* Manage procurement of lab supplies and chemicals, including vendor coordination and purchase orders.
* Enforce lab safety rules, hazardous material handling, and waste disposal practices.
* Develop and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for lab processes and safety protocols.
* Evaluate laboratory performance and advise on improvements to optimize efficiency.
* Promote teamwork, provide guidance, and help your team grow professionally.

This position requires participation in an on-call rotation for one week per month.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree with 2+ years of experience in a related scientific field (Biology, Chemistry, etc.).
* Bachelor's degree in Chemistry preferred.
* Proven leadership experience in a lab setting.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
* Good communication skills for working with your team and researchers.
* Knowledge of lab safety protocols and equipment handling.
* Comfortable using lab software and data analysis tools.
* A commitment to maintaining a safe and productive work environment.

At Eikon, employee compensation also includes bonus and equity compensation, in addition to several generous benefit programs, including:

* 401k plan with company matching

The expected salary range for this role is $95,000 to $105,000 depending on skills, competency, and the market demand for your expertise.

new_jobs.title: HCM Program Manager

RingCentral is looking for an HCM Program Manager to drive delivery of our Human Capital Management initiatives, from new module rollouts to upgrades, integrations, and process improvements. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll be the hands-on owner who keeps HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and our HCM vendor aligned and moving, and who makes sure what we launch actually gets adopted.

* Own testing and data migration execution, including end-to-end, parallel payroll, and user acceptance testing
* Lead change management, training, and communications so employees, managers, and HR teams adopt new processes
* Plan and run cutovers and go-lives, then manage hypercare and transition to ongoing support
* Surface risks early, escalate with options, and contribute to the HCM roadmap based on what you learn after launch

What you bring  
**Required**

* 5+ years of project or program management experience
* Hands-on experience driving at least one full-cycle HCM implementation on a platform such as UKG, ADP, Dayforce, Workday, Oracle, or SuccessFactors
* Working knowledge of core HR processes: hire-to-retire, payroll, time and attendance, benefits, and compensation
* Experience managing vendors and implementation partners against scope and SOW commitments
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through influence, without direct authority
* Strong command of project management tools and methods (Smartsheet, Jira, MS Project, or similar; Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid)

* Clear, confident communicator who can brief leadership and run a working session with equal ease

**Nice to have**

* PMP, CSM, or equivalent certification

* Background in change management (Prosci or similar)

The Port of San Francisco is an enterprise agency of the City and County of San Francisco and is governed by a Commission of five members appointed by the Mayor. The Port Commission is responsible for overseeing a broad range of waterfront commercial, maritime, and public access facilities that are held in public trust for the people of California. The Port’s jurisdiction covers approximately 7.5 miles of waterfront land from Pier 98, near Hunter’s Point in the southern part of San Francisco, to Fisherman’s Wharf in the northern part of the City.  
  
The Port’s diverse business portfolio includes over 550 ground, commercial, retail, office, industrial and maritime industrial leases including cargo shipping, layberthing, excursion boats, ferry boats, fishing and fish processing/distribution, tourism, filming, harbor services, and cruise operations. With some of the most flexible cargo handling facilities on the West Coast, as well as naturally deep water, the Port can handle various types of cargo such as, dry-bulk, neo-bulk, roll-on/roll-off, and project cargoes.

The Port of San Francisco has many internationally recognized landmarks such as Fisherman’s Wharf, Pier 39, the Exploratorium, the Ferry Building and Oracle Park, home of the San Francisco Giants baseball team. With its unique and historic properties, the Port is home to a variety of tenants and uses. The Port Commission over the last five decades has led a remarkable transformation of the Port; maintaining its industrial maritime heritage while developing new uses, including commercial and public activities, that have helped San Francisco remain one of the most visited and popular cities on the globe.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, AV Safety Policy & Programs
new_jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is building the safety capability for autonomous mobility. As Program Manager, AV Safety Policy & Programs, you'll own key parts of Lyft's AV Safety Management System (SMS) across all four pillars: Safety Policy, Safety Risk Management, Safety Assurance, and Safety Promotion. You'll also make sure the processes, documentation, and cross-functional machinery behind them work in practice.

This is a high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of safety policy, program design, and cross-functional process support. You'll author policy, run risk and review cadences, turn safety data into decisions, and keep the Safety Review Board (SRB) running. You'll work closely with AV partners, and you can speak credibly about AV safety with technical counterparts, senior leaders, and external partners.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Safety Policy:** Own Lyft's AV safety policy framework, safety procedures, and partner-facing governance documentation, including version control and periodic review cycles. Maintain governance charters, committee operating rhythms, and escalation protocols.
* **Safety Risk Management:** Run hazard identification and risk assessment for AV operations and new launches. Maintain the operational risk register and track mitigations to closure.
* **Safety Assurance:** Track safety performance indicators and trends, and surface emerging risks. Participate in incident and near-miss investigations and own corrective action (CAPA) tracking, so findings feed back into policy, operations, and partner work plans. Coordinate evidence and remediation for audits and certifications.
* **Safety Promotion:** Drive safety communications, lessons-learned documentation, and training readiness.
* **Safety Review Board:** Run the SRB cadence, including agendas, materials, decision records, and follow-through on action items.
* **Partner Engagement:** Contribute to the standards and assessment frameworks Lyft uses with AV partners, and support partners' safety assurance and risk management activities.
* **Program Execution:** Drive AV safety programs with safety leaders, including partners across EHS, Operations, Engineering, Legal, and others from inception through go-live. This includes safety readiness for new market launches and partner integrations.

**Experience:**
---------------

* 4+ years supporting or managing safety management programs in a safety-critical transportation industry (AV, aviation, rail, automotive, trucking, or equivalent)
* Working knowledge of SMS principles and how they apply to AV operations
* Hands-on experience with risk assessment, incident follow-up, and corrective action tracking
* Strong technical writing, including policy, procedures, and partner- or regulator-facing materials
* Comfort with safety data, including tracking indicators, spotting trends, and presenting findings to technical and senior audiences
* Proven ability to run multi-stakeholder programs without direct authority
* Bachelor's degree in safety, engineering, policy, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* **Nice to Have**
  + Familiarity with AV safety frameworks (e.g., AVSC best practices) and US AV reporting requirements
  + Experience supporting robotaxi, ridehail, or fleet operations
  + Experience operating in a matrixed, partner-dependent environment where safety policy must be implemented through influence rather than direct control
  + Exposure to multi-market or international safety operations

**Benefits:**
-------------

* Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
* Mental health benefits
* Family building benefits
* Child care and pet benefits
* 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
* In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
* 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
* Subsidized commuter benefits
* Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

The expected base pay range for this position in the San Francisco area is $108,000 - $135,000, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

new_jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, Energy Storage
new_jobs.description:
**About Redwood Materials**

**Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.**

**Position Summary:**

The Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, Energy Storage is a career-level individual contributor role that owns program management across all commodities supporting the Energy Storage business. The role builds and maintains the integrated supply chain schedule across commodity owners, suppliers, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Finance, tracks supplier milestones and risks, and drives material readiness for new product introduction builds and production ramp. The role works independently and is reviewed at critical points. This is a fully on-site role in our San Francisco R&D space, with approximately 10% international travel to supplier sites.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead the integrated supply chain program plan across all Energy Storage commodities (for example, electronics PCBAs, mechanical components, energy equipment, solar panels, and harnesses), tracking milestones, dependencies, and resources across suppliers and internal teams
* Serve as the liaison between Supply Chain commodity teams and Programs, Engineering, Manufacturing, Finance, and leadership, communicating program status, key milestones, and risks
* Identify supply and schedule risks early, and devise and drive mitigation plans with commodity owners and suppliers
* Coordinate supplier readiness for new product introduction builds and production ramp, including capacity, qualification, and delivery plans
* Track supply chain program metrics (cost, lead time, delivery performance, inventory) across commodities and report results to leadership
* Resolve cross-functional issues and escalations that affect program schedule, cost, or quality
* Develop and improve program management tools, templates, and processes for supply chain programs

**Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of program management, supply chain, or sourcing experience (3+ years with a Master's degree), ideally in energy storage, battery, EV, or electronics manufacturing
* Working knowledge of new product introduction, production ramp, and supply chain operations across electronic, mechanical, and electromechanical commodities
* Experience building and managing integrated schedules, milestone trackers, and risk registers across multiple stakeholders and commodity teams
* Ability to analyze supply chain data (cost, lead time, delivery, inventory) to identify trends and risks
* Ability to communicate program status and risks clearly, in writing and verbally, to cross-functional partners and leadership
* Ability to travel internationally to supplier sites approximately 10% of the time

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

  

We collect personal information (PI) from you in connection with your application for employment with Redwood Materials, including the following categories of PI: identifiers, personal records, professional or employment information, and inferences drawn from your PI. We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

new_jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
### **About AppLovin**

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com.

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

### **About the Role**

We are seeking a smart, hardworking Business Operations Analyst to provide technical and operational support to our Business Operations (BizOps) team and the systems supporting our mobile-advertising business.

A central part of this role is helping other BizOps analysts deliver reliable projects. You will review their code, debug existing workflows, investigate product issues, and translate business problems into actionable requests for Engineering and Operations. You will also write and maintain your own workflow code and analyze product features and experiments.

You will serve as a practical link between business and technical teams. We're looking for someone who learns quickly, investigates problems independently, exercises good judgment, and follows issues through to resolution.

AI-assisted development is a regular part of how our team works. You should be effective at using these tools and reviewing the code they produce, with the technical understanding to identify mistakes, challenge assumptions, and guide work toward reliable results.

* Manage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services supporting BizOps workflows, including service accounts, permissions, secrets, configuration, and deployments.
* Support Salesforce workflows and integrations, including programming against its application programming interfaces (APIs).
* Analyze product features, experiments, and operational and advertising data. Apply appropriate statistical methods, interpret results accurately, and explain limitations.
* Investigate discrepancies across internal systems and partner platforms.
* Prioritize competing requests and communicate findings, decisions, blockers, and next steps through concise Slack messages, tickets, and documentation.

* At least two years of relevant professional experience in business operations, technical operations, analytics, software development, or a related field.

* Strong problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar systems, connect information across sources, and work through ambiguous problems.
* A strong work ethic and sense of ownership: you take initiative, persist through difficult problems, and follow work through to completion.
* Good judgment about data quality, system changes, permissions, and operational risk. You recognize which problems you can resolve independently and when additional expertise or review is needed.
* Effective use of AI coding and workflow tools to develop, review, and maintain substantial volumes of code. You can evaluate generated work, identify mistakes, and steer it toward the intended outcome.
* Practical experience with Python, SQL, Git, pull-request workflows, and APIs, including investigating and debugging existing code.
* Hands-on experience managing GCP services and workflows, including permissions, credentials, configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Experience applying statistical analysis and data science techniques, including selecting appropriate methods, interpreting results accurately, and explaining limitations.
* Experience in advertising technology, with a working understanding of areas such as campaign delivery, attribution, measurement, mediation, monetization, or the iOS and Android ecosystems.
* Clear, concise written communication. You can explain technical issues in business terms, document reproducible problems, and write requirements and tickets that others can act on.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting internal tools, reviewing other people's code, or coordinating technical work across business, Engineering, and Operations teams.
* Experience with Salesforce administration, reporting, permission models, or integrations.
* Experience maintaining production automations, data pipelines, or shared internal applications.
* Familiarity with least-privilege access and sensitive data handling.

### **What Success Looks Like**

BizOps analysts can rely on you to investigate technical problems, review their work thoughtfully, and help their projects move forward. Engineering and Operations receive clear, actionable req

Many of our patients are navigating perimenopause or menopause and feel frustrated that the diet and exercise strategies that worked in the past are no longer producing the same results. We are looking for someone who can turn education into practical, personalized habits—and provide the encouragement and accountability patients need to follow through.

Dr Camille is a functional medicine doctor who helps them with hormone, thyroid and nutrient optimization, and highly recommends diet changes and weight lifting, but needs a health coach to provide accountability and support.

This role will initially focus on supporting existing patients, with the opportunity to help develop and deliver an expanded online coaching program.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement individualized care plans focused on nutrition, weight management, and strength training tailored specifically for women in midlife
* Provide motivational interviewing and behavioral health strategies to foster positive change and boost client confidence
* Offer emotional support and active listening to help clients overcome challenges and stay motivated throughout their wellness journey
* Conduct virtual coaching sessions via video conferencing software, ensuring clear communication and engagement
* Educate clients on healthy eating habits, weight loss techniques, and safe weight lifting practices aligned with their fitness levels and health conditions

**Who We’re Looking For**

* Understanding of how perimenopause and menopause can affect body composition, muscle mass, sleep, recovery, and weight management.

Join us in creating a vibrant community where women feel empowered to take charge of their health! This role is perfect for motivated professionals passionate about inspiring positive change through personalized coaching that combines nutrition expertise with strength training. We value energetic individuals committed to making a difference—apply today to become part of our wellness-focused team!

new_jobs.title: IT Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

The IT Operations Manager runs day-to-day IT operations, endpoint security, and support across Cordance HQ and its business units. The role is the hands-on owner of our IT tooling, our managed service providers, and the transition of business units onto a common HQ-managed platform.

Because Cordance operates across multiple business units, this role balances central standards with each unit's individual systems, audits, and deadlines. The IT Operations Manager also supplies the evidence and controls that business units need for SOC 2 and other security certifications.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **IT Operations and Support**

* Own IT service management across HQ and business units, including ticket quality, escalations, and SLAs with the helpdesk provider (currently 1Path).
* Run joiner, mover, and leaver processes, including provisioning and removing access across Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS, and business applications, working with HR on identity data from Rippling.
* Maintain and keep current the IT Operations Runbook, covering systems, procedures, contacts, and escalation paths.

### **Endpoint and Security Tooling**

* Administer the RMM and endpoint stack, including NinjaOne for device management and SentinelOne for EDR, and keep device inventories reconciled between them.
* Administer email and web security, including Abnormal Security and Cisco Umbrella, across multi-org and EU tenants.
* Enforce agent installation and device compliance on all company-managed devices and follow up with non-compliant users.
* Triage security alerts and integration health issues and route them to the appropriate team or provider.

### **Infrastructure and Cloud**

* Support the AWS landing zone and cloud access for business units and keep its documentation current.
* Manage identity, access, and tenant configuration across Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace environments.

### **Business Unit Integration and Vendor Management**

* Deliver IT and security integration workstreams that move business units from legacy MSPs onto HQ-managed tooling and in-house support.
* Hold MSPs and vendors accountable to deadlines for onboarding, offboarding, and tool removal, and report status and risk to leadership.
* Review and approve MSP invoices and manage hardware procurement with suppliers.

### **Compliance Support**

* Provide device, access, and configuration evidence for SOC 2 and other security certifications.
* Close gaps identified during audits and implement a continuous compliance framework to ensure infrastructure is audit-ready and compliant.

**Competencies**
----------------

* Strong IT operations and infrastructure management capabilities.
* Hands-on expertise managing identity, access, endpoints, and cloud environments.
* Ability to manage outsourced helpdesk providers, MSPs, and technology vendors against defined SLAs and deadlines.
* Ability to balance centralized IT standards with the needs of multiple business units and technology environments.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain accurate operational documentation and compliance evidence.
* Ability to communicate clearly with executives, vendors, and non-technical users.
* Strong ownership and follow-through when managing integrations, escalations, security issues, and audit requirements.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 7+ years of experience in IT operations or infrastructure, including 3+ years leading IT operations or managing MSPs.
* Hands-on administration of Microsoft 365 / Entra ID and Google Workspace, including identity, access, and tenant settings.
* Hands-on experience with an RMM platform, with NinjaOne preferred, and an EDR platform, with SentinelOne preferred.
* Working knowledge of AWS and Azure, including IAM, account structure, and landing zones.
* Proven record of managing outsourced helpdesk or MSP contracts against SLAs and deadlines.
* Experience supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits with technical evidence.
* Experience with M&A integration or running IT across several business units or tenants.
* Clear written communication with executives, vendors, and non-technical users.
* Bachelor's degree in IT, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with Abnormal Security, Cisco Umbrella, or similar email and DNS security tools.
* Scripting experience for automation using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert or AWS Certified SysOps Administrator certification.
* Security certification such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or CISM.
* Familiarity with GDPR and managing EU data residency across tenants.
* Experience working with a global team, including overlap with India (IST) hours.

**Success Measurements**
------------------------

* Consistent IT service delivery across Cordance HQ and its business units, including effective management of tickets, escalations

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Human Evaluations (Recommendations)
new_jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Great recommendations are how members find something worth their time. We are looking for an experienced Human Evaluations Program Manager to help us measure and improve the quality of recommendations across the Netflix homepage and discovery experience. You will work alongside Product Management and ML teams to build the human evaluation programs that tell us whether recommendations are working for members, and where they are not.

**About the Role**

Netflix is building toward more relevant, more varied, and more trustworthy recommendations, and thoughtful, high-quality evaluation is essential to making sure we are moving in the right direction. Join a team creating the frameworks, tools, and workflows that ensure human judgment is applied with consistency, clarity, and care, whether we are evaluating relevance, repetition, diversity, or whether a recommendation simply makes sense to the member.

You will not only shape how human evaluations of our recommendations are designed, but also own the day-to-day execution. From scoping and planning to vendor management, rater onboarding, and calibration, you will be accountable for driving delivery from start to finish. Just as critically, you will act as a thought partner to Product Management, helping translate recommendation strategy into evaluation designs and building a shared language around recommendation quality across teams.

**The Opportunity**

In this role, you will partner across product, research, data science, UX, and engineering to develop rubrics, frameworks, and workflows that enable rigorous, scalable human evaluation of recommendations. Beyond shaping the "what" and "how," you will also lead the "when" and "done." You will keep evaluation projects on track, ensuring consistent execution, timely delivery, efficient use of vendor capacity, and high rater alignment. If you are excited to bring structure to ambiguity and influence what members see when they open Netflix, while being accountable for tangible delivery, this is your chance to create meaningful impact from day one.

**The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of structure and flexibility. You know how to create evaluation frameworks that are rigorous and scalable, and you are also a driver who gets them out the door. You are skilled at translating product strategy into evaluation workflows, defining milestones, managing vendors, and delivering consistent results in a dynamic environment. You can steer teams across functions, keep timelines on track, and ensure rater quality without micromanaging. You are curious about how personalization works and can build credibility with PMs, data scientists, and ML engineers. You have working fluency in film and TV content and can quickly scan a set of titles to tell whether they belong together. You thrive in spaces where there is no roadmap, and you take pride in making things real, not just possible.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end execution of human evaluation and data operations initiatives, from intake and scoping to delivery
* Partner with Product Management to translate recommendation strategy and roadmap priorities into evaluation designs, success metrics, and timelines

* Oversee rater onboarding, calibration, and QA workflows
* Pilot and refine evaluation tasks to improve clarity, inter-rater reliability, and feedback quality
* Anticipate and resolve bottlenecks and blockers
Act as the connective tissue across product, ML, data science, and vendor partners to ensure alignment and effective execution of evaluations at scale  

**Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience working in human evaluations, data collection, labeling, or annotation operations in ML environments
* Track record of implementing process improvements or quality control systems for data collection needs
* Prior experience managing human annotation vendors, raters, or data labeling teams, including vendor performance and cost management
* Experience improving operational efficiency of annotation programs (throughput, turnaround, cost)
* Strong understanding of evaluation design, including guidelines, rubrics, and scoring protocols
* Working fluency in film and TV content, including genres, formats, and talent
* Proven ability in end-to-end management of complex, cross-functional programs, demonstrating strong Program Management skills and clear accountability for successful delivery
* Experience with human labeling platforms
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to synthesize feedback into clear recommendations and process improvements
* Familiarity with how rater subjectivity and bias affect taste-based judgments, and how to account for them in evaluation design
Strong organizational skills and executional focus; ability to track details while seeing the bigger picture  

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with personalization, recommender systems, search, or ranking evaluation
* Familiarity with how offline human evaluation complements online experimentation (A/B tests) and engagement metrics
* Experience evaluating at the list or page level, not only the individual item level
* Experience partnering with Product Managers and Data Scientists on metric

At Krystal Biotech, we bring together the brightest and most eager minds to relentlessly pursue the discovery, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of genetic medicines to treat diseases with high unmet medical needs.  
  
Founded in 2016, Krystal is distinguished in three powerful ways: science and technology using our patented gene therapy platform, innovative manufacturing supported by our commercial scale facilities, and a unique commercialization model that focuses on the patient’s end to end experience.  
  
Krystal received U.S. FDA approval for the first and only redosable gene therapy treatment, VYJUVEK®, for the treatment of Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (DEB). Krystal continues to leverage our proprietary platform to rapidly advance a robust pipeline of investigational genetic medicines in respiratory, oncology, dermatology, and ophthalmology.  
  
Krystal is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA which is home to our two state-of-the-art CGMP manufacturing facilities with teams around the world and satellite offices in Switzerland, Germany, and Japan. We are a company built and run by people who care, are fearless in the face of a challenge, love the work they do, and practice the highest level of scientific integrity. As we grow, we are seeking team members that embody these values.  
  
**Job Description Summary:**  
The Patient Access Liaison (PAL) is a field-based position that will provide product reimbursement, distribution, logistical, and other non-medical educational assistance to patients/caregivers as well as HCP office and site of care staff. The PAL will work with the patient and their health care providers to educate them on the requirements to gain access to therapy including information specific to prior authorization and appeals. The PAL will also work to maintain relationships with the patients and the office staff to support ongoing compliance with prescribed therapy, including as needed collaboration with specialty pharmacy and distributors.  
  
The PAL is a highly visible position and will have an assigned geographic region and requires strong teamwork to provide exceptional customer service to patients, caregivers, HCP staff as well as internal cross-functional teams. The Patient Access Liaisons must have experience in rare diseases including strong knowledge of reimbursement and distribution for buy & bill/medical benefit covered products.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
About HappyRobot  
  
HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

The Role  
  
As a Customer Success Manager, you will own the post-sale relationship with a portfolio of large, enterprise customers. You will make sure each customer sees real, measurable value from their AI workforce, and then help them expand it to new workflows, teams, and regions. You will work side by side with our forward-deployed engineers, deployment strategists, and account executives, and you will be the voice of the customer inside HappyRobot.  
This is a strategic role, not a support role. Our customers are adopting a new kind of technology, and you will guide them from first deployment to a fully scaled AI operation. We are especially interested in candidates with a logistics background who can earn the trust of large, complex organizations and speak the language of their operations teams.  
  
What You Will Do

* Own a portfolio of large enterprise accounts and act as the primary day-to-day and executive-level contact.
* Drive adoption and time-to-value by defining success metrics with each customer, such as resolution time, load coverage, calls automated, and cost savings.
* Run regular business reviews that translate performance data into clear business outcomes and next steps.
* Identify and lead expansion opportunities into new use cases, business units, and geographies, partnering closely with Sales.
* Partner with forward-deployed engineers and deployment strategists to scope, launch, and iterate on new workflows.
* Monitor account health, anticipate risk, and lead renewals with a clear view of value delivered.
* Capture customer feedback and turn it into actionable input for Product and Engineering.
* Build repeatable playbooks, onboarding materials, and best practices as the Customer Success function scales.

What You Bring

* 4 to 7 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS or technology company, with experience managing enterprise accounts.
* **Preferred:** Hands-on logistics, freight, or supply chain experience (for example at a freight broker, 3PL, carrier, shipper, or logistics technology company), ideally managing large, multi-stakeholder accounts.
* A track record of driving adoption, retention, and expansion, with comfort owning renewal and growth targets.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate with both operators on the floor and C-level stakeholders.
* Comfort with data. You can read usage and performance metrics, build a clear narrative around them, and recommend next steps.
* Technical curiosity. You do not need to code, but you should be comfortable discussing integrations, APIs, workflows, and AI concepts with customers and engineers.
* A bias for ownership and speed, with the ability to thrive in ambiguity at a fast-growing startup.

Nice to Have

* Experience with AI, automation, or voice products.
* Familiarity with TMS, WMS, or CRM systems.
* Spanish, Portuguese, or another language, given our LatAm and international customer base.
* Prior experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup.

Why Join Us

* Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
* Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital, and Eurazeo.
* Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
* Comprehensive benefits including healthcare, dental, and vision coverage.
* Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles  
  
**Extreme Ownership**  
We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting. If something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it is not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We do not wait for someone else to solve it. We lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

**Craftsmanship**  
Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping outcomes by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build, even when nobody is watching.

**We are “majos”**  
Be friendly and have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine and honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

**Urgency with Focus**  
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We are running a high-speed marathon, not a sprint with no strategy.

**Talent Density and Meritocracy**  
Hire only people who can raise the average; exceptional performance is the passing grade. Ability trumps seniority. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure.

**First-Principles Thinking**  
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, and rebuild the solution from scratch. We do not copy-paste solutions.

Compensation Range: $120K - $180K

new_jobs.title: Client Service and Operations Associate

Deep familiarity with LPL Financial and ClientWorks is preferred. Candidates with substantial experience using another major custodian or broker-dealer platform will also be considered.

new_jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Member Experience (Contract)
new_jobs.description:
### **Who are we?**

The Motley Fool is a purpose-driven financial services company on a mission to make the world smarter, happier, and richer. For 30 years, we've been helping people make better investment decisions through transparency, education, and a healthy dose of Foolish fun. We're a fast-moving, collaborative team that values high-quality work, curiosity, and initiative. We care deeply about what we do, and we're driven by the impact our work has on real people's financial futures.

### **The Role**

Once someone becomes a Motley Fool member, the product they use every day is what earns their renewal. Our vision moves us from stock picks to a full investing system and platform experience, this role owns building it.

As a Product Manager for Member Experience, you'll own the daily product surface — dashboard, portfolio tools, personalization, and mobile — built on top of the AI scoring and research engine our Intelligence team maintains.

### **What you'll do**

* With your cross-functional team, own member engagement as your core metric, the product-side driver of renewal.
* Anchor the Member Platform team (web and app). You own its backlog and the quality of the member-facing product: dashboard, portfolio tools, community, and mobile app roadmap.
* Own onboarding and activation — get new members to their first valuable action fast, so the value they signed up for lands in the first days, not weeks. This is where early renewal is won or lost.
* Build personalized experiences on top of our AI scoring engine, the right research and insight for the right member, partnering with our Intelligence team, who provide the underlying AI/scoring APIs — keeping personalization on the right side of the line between helpful and regulated investment advice.
* Design and ship features that turn a "read the email" habit into a daily or weekly product habit, across both the in-product and email experience.
* Run a continuous member-research and usage-analytics practice, so decisions are grounded in behavior, not assumption, and feed what you learn into offering and packaging decisions with our commercial and domain experts.
* Write specs precise enough for engineers and AI agents to build against, and bring a business case to our weekly product review. This is a decision-making forum, not a status update.

### **What we're looking for**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally on a consumer or subscription product with a strong engagement/retention focus
* A committed active investor with real skin in the game — you understand our members because you are one
* Experience building personalized or recommendation-driven product experiences is a strong plus
* AI-native working style — comfortable prototyping fast and working alongside AI agents day to day
* A strong product sense for daily-habit, engagement-driven experiences
* Strong stakeholder management — you'll work across engineering, design, and the Intelligence team every week
* Comfortable partnering with other product teams as well as marketing

**Compensation:**

Below is our target hourly rate. While we are budget conscious, we're also eager to find the right person for this role, so if your target is outside of this range, please don't hesitate to apply and we'd be happy to have a conversation.

*By applying on this site, you acknowledge that The Motley Fool will be collecting the personal data you provide for our recruiting purposes. Please see our* *Applicant Privacy Notice* *for additional information about how we process, transfer, and store your data, including where that data is stored, and about any additional privacy rights you may have based on your jurisdiction.*

new_jobs.description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.

**Introduction**

As a Senior Network Operations Analyst, you will join our Global Network Operations team and provide advanced technical and operational leadership for the network services supporting our offices, distribution centers, data centers, showrooms, and retail stores worldwide. You will lead complex incident response, guide other operations team members, and partner with engineering, information security, cloud, retail technology, field services, and external service providers to improve network reliability and operational maturity.

**About the Job**

* Serve as a senior technical escalation point, leading the investigation and resolution of complex network incidents across our global corporate, retail, distribution center, data center, and cloud environments.
* Coordinate major incident response across operations, engineering, information security, business teams, and service providers, ensuring clear ownership, timely communication, and effective resolution.
* Lead operational improvements across monitoring, alerting, problem management, documentation, lifecycle management, compliance, and change readiness to strengthen network reliability and service quality.
* Mentor Network Operations team members, provide day-to-day technical guidance, and help build the internal capabilities required to reduce dependency on external service providers.
